items.title: ProMaya: a hierarchical universal Deep Learning framework for accurate and interpretable Protein-Protein interaction identification
items.abstract_or_text: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) are molecular lego which define the physical states of cells. Accurately identifying PPIs remains challenging due to the interplay of several factors ranging from electrostatic to molecular geometry, topology, and physics. Existing computational approaches capture only fragments of this orchestra, limiting their generalizability across protein families and interaction types. Here, we present ProMaya, a hierarchical multi-scale Graph-transformer framework that integrates 3D atomic geometry, electronic distribution, residue-level structure and disorder, surface mass-density signatures, and large protein language-model embeddings of interacting proteins. Highly comprehensively benchmarked across nine species and 47 GB experimentally validated data, ProMaya achieved consistently >95% average accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art tools by >12%. As driven by its explainability, the first time introduced atomic and protein language information dramatically boosted it to an outstanding level for PPI discovery in any species, potent to even bypass costly experiments. ProMaya system is freely accessible at https://scbb.ihbt.res.in/ProMaya/
items.summary_zh: ProMaya以分层多尺度Graph-transformer整合原子几何、电子分布、残基结构与无序、表面特征及蛋白语言模型嵌入，用于PPI识别。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 摘要报告其在九个物种、47 GB实验验证数据上的比较结果，并提供公开系统；高性能与“绕过实验”等强主张尚待独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用（PPI）是定义细胞物理状态的分子乐高。由于静电、分子几何、拓扑和物理等多种因素相互作用，准确识别PPI仍具挑战性。现有计算方法只能捕捉这一整体中的片段，限制了它们跨蛋白家族和相互作用类型的泛化能力。这里，我们提出ProMaya：一种分层多尺度Graph-transformer框架，整合相互作用蛋白的三维原子几何、电子分布、残基层面结构和无序、表面质量密度特征以及大型蛋白质语言模型嵌入。在九个物种和47 GB实验验证数据上进行了高度全面的基准测试，ProMaya获得始终超过95%的平均准确率，比最先进工具高出12%以上。得益于其可解释性，首次引入的原子和蛋白语言信息极大提升了其性能，使其在任何物种的PPI发现中达到突出水平，甚至有可能绕过昂贵实验。ProMaya系统可在https://scbb.ihbt.res.in/ProMaya/免费访问。

items.title: De novo Rubisco design with protein language models
items.abstract_or_text: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (Rubisco) fixes the majority of carbon dioxide globally but is challenged with low specificity for CO2 versus O2 and low catalytic efficiencies. Traditional engineering efforts have remained difficult because folding, assembly, specificity, and catalysis are tightly coupled, hampering efforts to explore sequence space. Therefore, we leveraged recent advances in protein large language models (PLMs) to generate sequences beyond those observed in nature, using both ProGen-2 that was fine-tuned on a limited dataset of non-Form I Rubiscos and an ESM-2 discriminator. With this approach, we generated 5.6 million novel Rubisco-like sequences and identified 21 highly diverse candidates predicted to be active that occupy regions of Rubisco phylogenetic space not previously observed in nature. Six designs were soluble in Escherichia coli, and five were shown to produce quantifiable 3PGA. One design produced an apparent CO2/O2 specificity estimate beyond the range of the natural representative Rubiscos assayed. We also solved the crystal structure of one de novo design that reproduced the predicted dimer and active-site geometry with sub-angstrom C agreement. Sequence-only generation followed by independent structural filtering therefore recovered soluble, active Rubiscos from regions of sequence space that are not represented in genomic databases. Together, these results establish a scalable strategy for accessing previously unexplored Rubisco sequence space, providing a broadly accessible path toward generating de novo Rubiscos that may have activity and specificity parameters needed to address longstanding limitations in biological carbon fixation.
items.summary_zh: 以 ProGen-2 生成并由 ESM-2 筛选新型 Rubisco 序列；21个候选中6个可溶、5个产生可定量检测的 3PGA，且一个设计的晶体结构验证了预测二聚体与活性位点几何。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将序列生成、独立结构筛选与功能及结构实验串联，为拓展天然序列空间中的碳固定酶提供了有说服力的路径；活性与 CO2/O2 特异性仍需在更广泛条件和更多设计中验证。
items.abstract_zh: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase（Rubisco）固定了全球大部分二氧化碳，但其对 CO2 相对于 O2 的特异性低，且催化效率低。传统工程改造工作仍然困难，因为折叠、组装、特异性和催化紧密耦合，阻碍了对序列空间的探索。因此，我们利用蛋白质大语言模型（PLMs）的最新进展，使用在有限的非 Form I Rubisco 数据集上微调的 ProGen-2 以及 ESM-2 判别器，生成了超出自然界已观察到范围的序列。借助该方法，我们生成了560万个新型 Rubisco 样序列，并鉴定出21个预测具有活性的、高度多样化的候选物；它们位于此前在自然界未观察到的 Rubisco 系统发育空间区域。六个设计在 Escherichia coli 中可溶，五个被证明能产生可定量检测的 3PGA。一个设计产生了表观 CO2/O2 特异性估计值，超出所测定的天然代表性 Rubisco 的范围。我们还解析了一个从头设计的晶体结构，其重现了预测的二聚体和活性位点几何，具有亚埃级 C 一致性。因而，纯序列生成加上独立的结构筛选，能够从基因组数据库未覆盖的序列空间区域中获得可溶且有活性的 Rubisco。总之，这些结果建立了一种可扩展策略，用于进入此前未探索的 Rubisco 序列空间，为生成可能具有解决生物碳固定长期局限所需活性和特异性参数的从头 Rubisco 提供了一条广泛可及的路径。

items.title: ProteinSage: From implicit learning to explicit structural constraints for efficient protein language modeling
items.abstract_or_text: While protein language models typically rely on sequence-only pretraining objectives, this approach often fails to capture structural regularities and demands large datasets. To address this, we introduce ProteinSage, a pretraining framework that learns protein representations under explicit structural constraints. ProteinSage incorporates structural signals via structure-guided masking and a causal objective designed to model longrange dependencies. This structure-constrained pretraining equips ProteinSage with transferable representations using less data and computation, yet achieves competitive or superior performance across diverse structure-aware and general protein modeling benchmarks. To determine whether these gains stem from genuine structural generalization rather than task-specific fitting, we applied ProteinSage to a structure-driven protein discovery task, focusing on proteins with multi-pass transmembrane helical architectures such as distantly related microbial rhodopsins. The model successfully identified six previously unannotated microbial rhodopsin homologs. Together, our work establishes structure-constrained pretraining as an effective pathway toward data-efficient and structurally faithful protein representation learning.
items.summary_zh: ProteinSage在蛋白语言模型预训练中引入结构引导掩码和建模长程依赖的因果目标，并报告发现6个未注释微生物视紫红质同源物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将结构约束直接引入预训练目标，并以远缘跨膜蛋白发现作为结构泛化检验；结论仍来自预印本。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管蛋白质语言模型通常依赖仅基于序列的预训练目标，但这种方法往往无法捕捉结构规律，且需要大型数据集。为解决这一问题，我们提出ProteinSage：一种在显式结构约束下学习蛋白质表示的预训练框架。ProteinSage通过结构引导掩码和旨在建模长程依赖的因果目标引入结构信号。这种受结构约束的预训练使ProteinSage能够以更少的数据和计算获得可迁移表示，同时在多种结构感知和通用蛋白质建模基准上实现有竞争力或更优的性能。为确定这些增益是否源于真正的结构泛化而非任务特异性拟合，我们将ProteinSage应用于一项结构驱动的蛋白质发现任务，聚焦具有多跨膜螺旋架构的蛋白质，如远缘相关的微生物视紫红质。该模型成功识别出6个此前未注释的微生物视紫红质同源物。总之，我们的工作确立了受结构约束的预训练是通向数据高效且结构保真蛋白质表示学习的有效路径。

items.title: A Zero-Shot Single-Point Chemical Language Model Mimics Medicinal Chemist Reasoning for Molecular Optimization and STING Inhibitor Development in Alzheimer’s Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Drug development relies heavily on the ability of medicinal chemists to identify productive, localized structural modifications that improve potency, selectivity, and developability while preserving favorable features of a lead scaffold. Here, we introduce the Single-Point Chemical Language Model (SpCLM), a zero-shot molecular optimization framework designed to computationally emulate this iterative medicinal chemistry paradigm. Built on a Transformer architecture, SpCLM performs controlled single-point molecular modifications encompassing common medicinal chemistry operations and generates focused, chemically interpretable analog spaces rather than large, unconstrained molecular libraries. This strategy enables efficient exploration of structure–activity relationships while maintaining close structural relationships to experimentally tractable lead compounds. Across multiple protein targets and molecular optimization tasks, SpCLM generated compact libraries typically comprising only a few hundred molecules, yet recovered 60%–80% of experimentally validated active compounds from held-out test sets that were not included during model training. Generated molecules showed substantial agreement with experimentally observed structure–activity relationships, including changes in binding affinity and functional activity, demonstrating that the model can reproduce productive chemical transformations without target-specific retraining. These results establish single-point molecular editing as an efficient strategy for translating learned medicinal chemistry knowledge into experimentally relevant molecular optimization. We further applied SpCLM to the development of stimulator of interferon genes (STING) inhibitors as potential therapeutics for Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Because aberrant activation of the cGAS–STING innate immune pathway contributes to neuroinflammatory processes associated with AD and related neurodegenerative disorders, pharmacological inhibition of STING represents an emerging therapeutic strategy. Starting from experimentally characterized STING inhibitor chemotypes, SpCLM generated focused analog series through medicinal-chemistry-like single-point modifications. Integration of model-guided generation with structure-based prioritization and experimental evaluation enabled efficient exploration and optimization of STING inhibitor chemical space, identifying analogs with improved activity and providing experimentally supported structure–activity relationships for further lead development. Together, these results demonstrate that SpCLM bridges generative molecular modeling and practical medicinal chemistry by converting broad chemical knowledge into focused, experimentally actionable structural modifications. By recovering a substantial fraction of experimentally active chemical space from only hundreds of generated candidates and enabling the optimization of therapeutically relevant STING inhibitor chemotypes, SpCLM provides a generalizable framework for reducing the experimental search space and accelerating iterative drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 提出零样本 Single-Point Chemical Language Model（SpCLM），以受控的单点分子编辑生成小型、可解释的类似物空间；并将模型引导设计、结构优先级排序和实验评价用于 STING 抑制剂优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 相较大规模无约束生成，该策略更贴近药物化学的局部 SAR 优化且报告了实验支持；60%–80%活性回收率及其跨靶点可推广性仍取决于保留集定义和后续外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 药物开发在很大程度上依赖于药物化学家识别富有成效的、局部的结构修饰的能力；这些修饰可在保留先导骨架有利特征的同时改善效力、选择性和可开发性。我们在此介绍 Single-Point Chemical Language Model（SpCLM），一种零样本分子优化框架，旨在计算上模拟这一迭代式药物化学范式。SpCLM 构建于 Transformer 架构之上，执行涵盖常见药物化学操作的受控单点分子修饰，生成聚焦且化学上可解释的类似物空间，而非庞大、无约束的分子库。该策略能够高效探索构效关系，同时与实验上可处理的先导化合物保持紧密结构关系。跨多个蛋白靶点和分子优化任务，SpCLM 生成的紧凑文库通常仅包含数百个分子，却从未纳入模型训练的留出测试集中找回了60%–80%经实验验证的活性化合物。生成分子与实验观察到的构效关系高度一致，包括结合亲和力和功能活性的变化，表明该模型无需靶点特异性再训练即可重现富有成效的化学转化。这些结果确立了单点分子编辑作为一种高效策略，可将习得的药物化学知识转化为与实验相关的分子优化。我们进一步将 SpCLM 应用于作为 Alzheimer’s disease（AD）潜在疗法的 stimulator of interferon genes（STING）抑制剂开发。由于 cGAS–STING 先天免疫通路的异常激活会促进与 AD 及相关神经退行性疾病相关的神经炎症过程，对 STING 进行药理学抑制代表一种新兴治疗策略。以实验表征过的 STING 抑制剂化学型为起点，SpCLM 通过药物化学式的单点修饰生成聚焦的类似物系列。将模型引导生成与基于结构的优先级排序和实验评价相结合，能够高效探索和优化 STING 抑制剂化学空间，鉴定出活性改善的类似物，并为进一步先导开发提供了实验支持的构效关系。总体而言，这些结果表明，SpCLM 通过将广泛化学知识转化为聚焦、可实验实施的结构修饰，在生成分子建模与实用药物化学之间架起桥梁。通过仅从数百个生成候选物中找回实验活性化学空间的很大部分，并实现对具有治疗相关性的 STING 抑制剂化学型的优化，SpCLM 提供了一个通用框架，可减少实验搜索空间并加速迭代式药物发现。

items.title: Dynamic vacancy redistribution shifts Pd nanoparticle coalescence from orientation-gated to defect-enabled on reduced CeO2(110)
items.abstract_or_text: Sintering deactivates supported catalysts, yet how mobile support defects couple to crystallographic transport anisotropy during nanoparticle coalescence remains poorly understood. Here, we develop a ternary Ce–O–Pd machine-learning interatomic potential (Ce–O–Pd MLIP) by fine-tuning a pre-trained large atomic model and validate it against density functional theory (DFT) calculations and ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD). Large-scale deep potential molecular dynamics (DPMD) simulations resolve early-stage coarsening of Pd 62 /Pd 287 nanoparticle pairs on CeO 2–x (110) and reveal direction-selective coalescence: [11̅0]-aligned pairs exhibit higher probabilities and shorter onset times than [001]-aligned pairs. CI-NEB calculations identify complementary transport anisotropies, with Pd adatom diffusion favored along [11̅0] and oxygen-vacancy migration favored along [001], enabling dynamic defect redistribution within the interparticle region. Statistical trajectory analysis shows that increasing the interparticle oxygen-vacancy fraction from 10% to 30% raises coalescence probability and accelerates bridge and neck nucleation, including along the kinetically less favorable [001] alignment. Time-resolved metrics further show that transient low-coordinated bridge-Pd intermediates precede complete particle merging. Together, these results establish defect–transport coupling as a microscopic mechanism for direction-selective sintering on reduced ceria and suggest that suppressing vacancy enrichment and connectivity in interparticle gaps can improve the stability of oxide-supported metal nanoparticles.
items.summary_zh: 以经 DFT 和 AIMD 验证的 Ce–O–Pd MLIP 开展大规模 DPMD，揭示还原 CeO2(110) 上氧空位动态再分布与 Pd 纳米颗粒定向烧结之间的耦合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将原子势模型、CI-NEB 和统计轨迹结合，给出抑制氧化物负载金属纳米颗粒烧结的微观设计线索；结论主要来自模拟，真实催化剂表面的复杂性仍需原位实验检验。
evidence_flags: 缺少直接原位实验验证
items.abstract_zh: 烧结会使负载型催化剂失活，但可移动的载体缺陷如何在纳米颗粒聚并过程中与晶体学传输各向异性耦合，仍知之甚少。这里，我们通过微调预训练的大原子模型，开发了一个 Ce–O–Pd machine-learning interatomic potential（Ce–O–Pd MLIP），并以 density functional theory（DFT）计算和 ab initio molecular dynamics（AIMD）对其进行验证。大尺度 deep potential molecular dynamics（DPMD）模拟解析了 CeO2–x (110) 上 Pd62/Pd287 纳米颗粒对的早期粗化，揭示了方向选择性聚并：[11̅0] 取向的颗粒对比较[001]取向的颗粒对具有更高概率和更短起始时间。CI-NEB 计算鉴定出互补的传输各向异性：Pd 吸附原子扩散沿[11̅0]更有利，而氧空位迁移沿[001]更有利，从而使缺陷能在颗粒间区域内动态重新分布。统计轨迹分析表明，将颗粒间氧空位分数从10%增加到30%，会提高聚并概率并加速桥接和颈部成核，包括沿动力学上较不利的[001]取向。时间分辨指标进一步表明，瞬态低配位 bridge-Pd 中间体先于颗粒完全合并出现。总之，这些结果确立了缺陷–传输耦合是还原 ceria 上方向选择性烧结的微观机制，并表明抑制颗粒间隙中氧空位的富集和连通性可改善氧化物负载金属纳米颗粒的稳定性。

items.title: A Transferable Genomic Language Model Framework for Fungal Gene Essentiality Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting biological function from genomic sequence remains a major challenge in computational and systems biology. Here, we tested whether the genomic language model Evo2, which encodes context-dependent DNA sequence patterns into embeddings, enables prediction of essential genes in fungi, a phenotype central to fungal biology and antifungal target discovery. We found that model performance was constrained not by the type or complexity of the downstream classifier, but by the biological information contained in Evo2 DNA embeddings. Specifically, the information recoverable from these embeddings progressively declined for biological features further downstream of DNA sequence, revealing a bottleneck for predicting higher-order cellular phenotypes. We alleviated this bottleneck by integrating Evo2 embeddings with two sequence-informed, system-level features: ortholog-based essentiality and protein-protein interactions. The multimodal framework demonstrated consistent performance both within and across three evolutionarily divergent yeasts (Candida albicans, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, and Schizosaccharomyces pombe), and its predictions were supported by published experimental evidence when transferred to the filamentous mold Aspergillus fumigatus. These results establish our framework as a transferrable tool for predicting essential genes across fungal genomes, including species with limited or no experimentally determined essentially data.
items.summary_zh: 该框架将Evo2 DNA嵌入与直系同源必需性及PPI特征结合，以预测三种进化差异显著酵母中的基因必需性，并向烟曲霉迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果明确揭示仅序列嵌入预测高阶细胞表型的瓶颈，并提供跨物种、多模态补充的可检验路线；烟曲霉证据来自已发表实验结果支持。
items.abstract_zh: 从基因组序列预测生物学功能仍是计算生物学和系统生物学的一项重大挑战。这里，我们测试了将依赖上下文的DNA序列模式编码为嵌入的基因组语言模型Evo2，是否能够预测真菌中的必需基因；这一表型对真菌生物学和抗真菌靶点发现至关重要。我们发现，模型性能不受下游分类器类型或复杂度的限制，而受Evo2 DNA嵌入中所含生物学信息的限制。具体而言，可从这些嵌入中恢复的信息会随着生物学特征距离DNA序列越远而逐渐下降，揭示了预测高阶细胞表型的瓶颈。我们通过将Evo2嵌入与两类由序列启发的系统层面特征整合来缓解这一瓶颈：基于直系同源物的必需性和蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用。该多模态框架在三种进化差异显著的酵母（Candida albicans、Saccharomyces cerevisiae和Schizosaccharomyces pombe）内及其间均表现出一致性能；当迁移至丝状霉菌Aspergillus fumigatus时，其预测得到已发表实验性证据的支持。这些结果将我们的框架确立为一种可迁移工具，用于预测各类真菌基因组中的必需基因，包括实验确定的必需性数据有限或没有此类数据的物种。
items.author_line: Liao, C., Thomas, H.

items.title: A Transformer-Based Delta Expression Encoder for Psilocybin Transcriptional Response: Architecture, Representations, and Biological Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding why individuals respond differently to psilocybin requires modeling the drug's transcriptional perturbation signature at the cell-type level. I present a Transformer-based delta expression encoder that learns to classify differential gene expression status - upregulated, downregulated, or neutral - from single-nucleus RNA-sequencing data, without supervision from pathway annotations or prior biological knowledge. The model is trained on pseudobulk profiles from 623 examples spanning 18 cell types, 2 drug conditions, and 6 timepoints derived from the Liao et al. 2025 dataset, and achieves 69.4% weighted classification accuracy. Three principal findings are reported, alongside one direct test of a published hypothesis that returned a result inconsistent with that hypothesis. First, per-cell-type classification accuracy ranges from 28.3% (L2/3 IT, a primary HTR2A-expressing psilocybin target) to 99.6% (endothelial cells), consistent with known psilocybin response biology. Second, psilocybin-induced transcriptional downregulation is significantly more stereotyped across individuals than upregulation (Mann-Whitney U=18615.0, p<0.0001), a novel finding with a cortical depth gradient across excitatory subtypes. Third, attention-guided gene co-regulation analysis recovers drug-specific modules without pathway supervision. Separately, a direct test of whether baseline HTR2A expression predicts drug-response separability across cell types found a significant negative correlation (Spearman r = -0.7088, p = 0.0021), the opposite of what a simple HTR2A-gating account would predict.
items.summary_zh: Delta expression encoder从单核RNA-seq伪bulk数据预测裸盖菇素转录变化方向，并检验细胞类型差异与HTR2A假说。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究保留了与既有HTR2A门控解释不一致的直接检验结果，提供了针对细胞类型特异药物扰动的可反驳分析；样本规模有限。
items.abstract_zh: 理解个体为何对裸盖菇素产生不同反应，需要在细胞类型层面建模该药物的转录扰动特征。我提出了一种基于Transformer的差异表达编码器，它无需通路注释或既有生物学知识的监督，即可从单核RNA测序数据中学习分类差异基因表达状态——上调、下调或中性。该模型在源自Liao等人2025年数据集的623个伪bulk样本上训练，覆盖18种细胞类型、2种药物条件和6个时间点，取得69.4%的加权分类准确率。报告了三项主要发现，以及一项对已发表假说的直接检验；该检验得到与该假说不一致的结果。第一，各细胞类型分类准确率从28.3%（L2/3 IT，一种主要的HTR2A表达型裸盖菇素靶标）到99.6%（内皮细胞）不等，这与已知的裸盖菇素反应生物学一致。第二，与上调相比，裸盖菇素诱导的转录下调在个体间显著更为刻板（Mann-Whitney U=18615.0，p<0.0001），这是一个具有跨兴奋性亚型皮层深度梯度的新发现。第三，注意力引导的基因共调控分析无需通路监督即可恢复药物特异性模块。另行地，针对基线HTR2A表达是否预测细胞类型间药物反应可分离性的直接检验，发现显著负相关（Spearman r=-0.7088，p=0.0021），这与简单HTR2A门控解释所预测的方向相反。

items.title: Agent-driven Model Development for RNA 3D Structure Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promise in driving scientific discovery, but their effectiveness in complex, real-world biological problems remains underexplored. We ask whether a general-purpose LLM agent can drive semi-autonomous development of a model for a genuinely hard biological problem, RNA 3D structure prediction. We designed a development loop where, under a fixed budget and with human supervision, the agent iteratively proposed, implemented, trained, and evaluated model changes. Over 297 iterations, the model evolved from a randomly-initialised baseline to QuickFold, an 8.9M-parameter folding trunk that matches the strongest open-source baselines (RhoFold+, NuFold) on lDDT and TM-score within noise on a held-out test set at a fraction of their inference cost. We frame this less as a new predictor than as a case study in feedback-driven, agent-led model development.
items.summary_zh: 在固定预算和人工监督下，通用LLM智能体经历297轮提出、实现、训练和评估迭代，将随机基线发展为RNA 3D结构预测模型QuickFold。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将重点放在有监督、反馈驱动的智能体模型开发案例，而非宣称新预测器；其与开源基线的比较仍需独立复现。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体已显示出推动科学发现的前景，但其在复杂、真实生物学问题中的有效性仍缺乏探索。我们询问，一个通用LLM智能体能否推动针对真正困难的生物学问题——RNA三维结构预测——的半自主模型开发。我们设计了一个开发循环：在固定预算和人工监督下，智能体迭代地提出、实现、训练并评估模型修改。经过297次迭代，模型从随机初始化的基线演变为QuickFold：一个拥有8.9M参数的折叠主干网络；它在留出测试集上的lDDT和TM-score与最强开源基线（RhoFold+、NuFold）在噪声范围内相当，同时推理成本仅为后者的一小部分。我们将其定位为反馈驱动、智能体主导模型开发的案例研究，而非一种新的预测器。

items.title: Deposon: An Auditable, Conservation-Guaranteed, Game-Theoretically Tested Scattering Layer over LLM Reasoning Paths
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-step LLM reasoning lacks a machine-recheckable ledger: discarded reasoning paths leave no auditable record. We propose the Deposon scattering layer, which binds each node of an LLM-generated concept-decomposition graph to a two-parameter Deposon state; paths undergo three-channel scattering -- transmission, reflection, irreversible dissipation -- obeying T+R+A=1 for arbitrary parameters, with a maximum per-path energy-audit deviation of 2.2E-16 (machine epsilon). We report all three evidence tiers honestly. On synthetic trap benchmarks the path-filtering gain is closed (pre-registered): unified reaches 100% versus a decoy-capture baseline at 7%/10%. On real benchmarks the layer is indistinguishable from a trivial six-keyword rule filter (GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85, McNemar p=0.5; StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899); no difference is detected here, so we sharpen the claim to "the differential value lies solely in machine verifiability." Fusion yields a second negative result: convex combinations with a semantic prior never improve (physics 0.484 -> 0.452), and the apparent lambda=2 gain is an anti-field artifact; any fusion gain must be nonlinear. Modeling the reverse dynamics as a potential game on the graph, we evidence an auditable scalar's monotonicity and near-gradientness and quantify the empirical coordination ratio (ECR). The three formalized dynamical-equivalence propositions (P1a/P1b/T-P1c) are falsified under the pre-registered kill protocol, and the potential-game claim is downgraded to approximate (cyclic-graph median residual 0.669): only consistency-level evidence survives at the dynamical level. Code: github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon.
items.summary_zh: Deposon 为 LLM 推理路径建立由传输、反射和不可逆耗散组成的可审计散射账本，并明确报告其在真实基准上未优于简单关键词过滤器等负结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将机器精度下的守恒检查、预注册的合成陷阱测试与可证伪命题并列报告，且收缩了不被结果支持的动力学主张；其价值主要是审计性，而不是已证实的真实任务性能增益。
items.abstract_zh: 多步 LLM 推理缺少可由机器复查的账本：被舍弃的推理路径不会留下可审计记录。我们提出 Deposon 散射层，它将 LLM 生成的概念分解图中的每个节点绑定到一个双参数 Deposon 状态；路径经历三个通道的散射——透射、反射、不可逆耗散——并且对任意参数均满足 T+R+A=1，单条路径能量审计偏差最大为 2.2E-16（机器精度）。我们如实报告全部三层证据。在合成陷阱基准上，路径过滤增益是封闭的（预注册）：统一方法达到 100%，而诱饵捕获基线为 7%/10%。在真实基准上，该层与简单的六关键词规则过滤器无法区分（GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85，McNemar p=0.5；StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899）；这里没有检测到差异，因此我们将主张收紧为“差异化价值仅在于机器可验证性”。融合带来了第二个负结果：与语义先验的凸组合从未改善表现（physics 0.484 -> 0.452），而表面上的 lambda=2 增益是反场伪影；任何融合增益都必须是非线性的。将反向动力学建模为图上的势博弈后，我们为一个可审计标量的单调性和近似梯度性提供证据，并量化经验协调比（ECR）。三个形式化的动力学等价命题（P1a/P1b/T-P1c）在预注册的终止协议下被证伪，势博弈主张被降级为近似主张（循环图中位残差 0.669）：在动力学层面，只有一致性层面的证据得以保留。代码：github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon。
items.author_line: Qihao Yuan

items.title: Certified Topological Interaction in Neural Representations: Class Disentanglement Is Mostly Pairwise
items.abstract_or_text: Class disentanglement (the separation of a representation's class-conditional point clouds along depth and over training) is usually read off descriptive curves. We measure it as certified topological interaction between labeled point clouds, using the recently introduced Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile: the Euler characteristic of the overlap of the clouds' ball unions as a function of scale, computed by one Alpha-complex sweep with no boundary-matrix reduction. Every number carries a test: exact permutation tests in both directions, a guarded separation certificate, and a paired test for the comparative claims applications make. Across 111 trained networks and 52,650 certified measurements, disentanglement is depth-graded and concentrated in the first epochs, and interaction quotients rank class pairs by confusability (Spearman rho=0.83), on par with cheap separability statistics. In a 96-model factorial population, augmentation is the one training choice that separates classes relative to chance; weight decay compresses the overlap without separating, and depth and width do nothing. The structural finding is one only a k-fold statistic can pose: the joint entanglement of a class triple sits below that of its strongest pair in 97% of triple-layer cells and 99.5% of deep cells, far below a measured null floor, in vision encoders and frozen language models alike. This pairwise dominance is a regularity, not a law: expected from the nesting of overlaps but not forced by geometry, present at initialization and in raw pixels, and manufactured in the last stage alone when a network memorizes random labels. The unnormalized profile mass predicts test accuracy (R^2=0.94), the quotient does not, and neither beats a linear probe. One lesson is reported in full: the paired test must use a scale-free statistic, or it certifies feature-norm dynamics as disentanglement.
items.summary_zh: 该研究用 Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile 定量神经表示中带标签点云的拓扑交互，并对 111 个网络的 52,650 项测量使用精确置换检验和配对检验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它区分了统计显著的类别分离、表征范数变化与线性探针性能，并把“三类纠缠主要由最强的成对纠缠决定”明确表述为经验规律而非几何定律。
items.abstract_zh: 类别解缠结（表示的类别条件点云沿网络深度和训练过程发生分离）通常通过描述性曲线读取。我们将其测量为带标签点云之间经过认证的拓扑交互，使用最近提出的 Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile：作为尺度函数的云球并集重叠部分的 Euler 特征数，通过一次 Alpha-complex 扫描计算，无需边界矩阵约化。每个数值都带有一个检验：双向精确置换检验、受保护的分离证书，以及针对应用所作比较主张的配对检验。在 111 个训练好的网络和 52,650 项认证测量中，解缠结随深度分级，并集中在最初几个训练轮次；交互商按可混淆性为类别对排序（Spearman rho=0.83），与廉价的可分性统计量相当。在一个含 96 个模型的析因总体中，数据增强是唯一相对于随机机会能分离类别的训练选择；权重衰减压缩重叠但不造成分离，深度和宽度都不起作用。结构性发现只能由 k 元统计量提出：一个类别三元组的联合纠缠，在 97% 的三元组-层单元和 99.5% 的深层单元中低于其最强类别对的纠缠，远低于测得的零假设下限；这一结果在视觉编码器和冻结语言模型中都成立。这种成对主导性是一种规律，而不是定律：可由重叠的嵌套关系预期，但不受几何强制；它在初始化和原始像素中就存在，而当网络记忆随机标签时，仅在最后阶段被制造出来。未归一化的 profile 质量预测测试准确率（R^2=0.94），交互商不能，且两者都不优于线性探针。本文完整报告的一条教训是：配对检验必须使用无尺度统计量，否则它会把特征范数动力学认证为解缠结。
items.author_line: Sushovan Majhi

items.title: Acoustic Emission to Provide Early Warning Detection of Lithium-Ion Battery Thermal Runaway
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding lithium-ion battery (LIB) degradation pathways and failure mechanisms is essential given the rare but potentially severe associated hazards. Recent regulations on thermal runaway prevention are driving the need for advanced early detection diagnostic techniques. Acoustic methods, including Acoustic Emission (AE) and Ultrasonic Testing (UT), are promising operando monitoring tools owing to their cost-effectiveness, non-invasive nature, and real-time capability to detect physical and electrochemical changes within cells. This study demonstrates the first use of AE as a diagnostic tool for monitoring stateof-health (SoH), state of safety, and early failure onset. AE measurements were correlated with high-speed synchrotron X-ray radiography, linking acoustic signals to real-time physical changes such as gas formation, cell-volume expansion, and cracking. Experiments across a range of SoC and SoH, covering pristine, aged, and cells cycled below 0 ºC, highlight the robustness of the approach. Machine learning algorithms trained across multiple chemistries and formats enabled real-time signal interpretation. AE reliably identified degradation mechanisms and issued failure alerts across a spectrum of severity, 2 including in lithium-plated cells, with synchrotron imaging confirming the physical origin of key signals. Integrating AE into battery management systems could significantly enhance LIB safety across automotive, grid storage, and manufacturing applications without compromising cost.
items.summary_zh: 以声发射结合高速同步辐射 X 射线成像监测锂离子电池热失控早期过程，并训练跨化学体系和电池形态的机器学习模型进行实时信号判读。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把低成本、非侵入式声学监测与物理成像验证结合，具有进入电池管理系统的应用潜力；不同使用场景下的误报率、泛化性及工程部署仍是关键限制。
items.abstract_zh: 鉴于相关危害虽罕见但可能严重，理解锂离子电池（LIB）劣化路径和失效机制至关重要。近期关于预防热失控的法规推动了对先进早期检测诊断技术的需求。声学方法，包括 Acoustic Emission（AE）和 Ultrasonic Testing（UT），因其成本效益、非侵入性以及实时检测电池内部物理和电化学变化的能力，而成为很有前景的 operando 监测工具。本研究展示了首次将 AE 用作监测健康状态（SoH）、安全状态和早期失效起始的诊断工具。AE 测量与高速同步辐射 X 射线照相相关联，将声学信号与气体形成、电池体积膨胀和开裂等实时物理变化联系起来。覆盖原始、老化和低于0 ºC循环的电池、并跨越一系列 SoC 和 SoH 的实验，突出了该方法的稳健性。针对多种化学体系和形态训练的机器学习算法实现了实时信号解释。AE 能可靠识别劣化机制，并针对不同严重程度发出失效警报，包括在锂析出的电池中；同步辐射成像确认了关键信号的物理起源。将 AE 整合到电池管理系统中，能够在不损害成本的情况下，显著提高汽车、电网储能和制造领域的 LIB 安全性。

items.title: PharmCast: rapid generation of three-dimensional pharmacophore fingerprints from two-dimensional structure without conformer generation
items.abstract_or_text: A three-dimensional pharmacophore fingerprint records the binding features a molecule can present. It is a description of a hand in search of a glove. Because it is defined by presented features instead of two-dimensional structure, it can identify pharmacophoric similarity between structurally distinct compounds, which is what scaffold hopping and non-obvious me-too design require. The descriptor has remained a niche tool because its cost is dominated by conformer generation. In the reference pipeline, generating 100 conformers requires 2.82 s of the 2.86 s needed to fingerprint one screening collection compound; the bit calculation requires 0.039 s. We therefore removed the conformational stage. PharmCast is a feedforward neural network that predicts all 10,549 bits of a PharmPrint ensemble fingerprint directly from a SMILES string. On the same machine, PharmCast generated pharmacophore fingerprints for two molecules and compared them in 0.584 ms, whereas the conventional conformer-based pipeline took 5.71 s. PharmCast version 10 was trained on 5,887,229 molecules drawn from a screening collection, activity-backed ChEMBL compounds from 142 to 1000 Da, and peptide loops excised from crystal structures. We evaluated 155,648 purchasable catalog compounds excluded from every training set, 139,700 activity-backed ChEMBL compounds not present in the version 10 training set, and 13,500 peptide loops reserved for testing. Median fingerprint error, Pearson r, and pairwise ranking accuracy were 0.008, 0.980, and 0.936 for screening collection chemistry; 0.016, 0.984, and 0.952 for loop peptides; and 0.027, 0.936, and 0.889 for activity-backed ChEMBL compounds. The reference calculation reproduces itself at an error of 0.006 and r of 0.995. Ensemble pharmacophore fingerprints can therefore be predicted from two-dimensional structure alone at a cost suitable for large-scale collection screening and virtual library exploration. Keywords: pharmacophore, fingerprint, scaffold hopping, surrogate model, virtual screening, applicability domain
items.summary_zh: PharmCast 以 SMILES 直接预测10,549位 PharmPrint 集合药效团指纹，省去构象生成；在多种排除训练集的化学空间中报告高指纹相关性和排序准确性，并显著降低计算时间。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若能保持化学检索有效性，二维结构到三维集合药效团的替代模型可降低虚拟筛选成本并支持 scaffold hopping；指纹逼近精度不直接等同于实际命中率或结合活性。
items.abstract_zh: 三维药效团指纹记录一个分子能够呈现的结合特征。它是寻找手套的一只手。由于它由呈现的特征而非二维结构定义，因此它能够识别结构不同化合物之间的药效团相似性，这正是 scaffold hopping 和非显而易见的 me-too 设计所需要的。该描述符一直是小众工具，因为其成本主要由构象生成决定。在参考流程中，为一个筛选化合物库分子生成100个构象，占指纹计算2.86 s所需时间中的2.82 s；位计算仅需0.039 s。因此我们移除了构象阶段。PharmCast 是一个前馈神经网络，可直接从 SMILES 字符串预测 PharmPrint ensemble fingerprint 的全部10,549位。在同一台机器上，PharmCast 为两个分子生成药效团指纹并进行比较仅需0.584 ms，而传统的基于构象流程需5.71 s。PharmCast version 10 在5,887,229个分子上训练，这些分子来自筛选化合物库、分子量142至1000 Da的具有活性支持的 ChEMBL 化合物，以及从晶体结构中切出的肽环。我们评估了155,648个从所有训练集中排除的可购买目录化合物、139,700个未出现在 version 10 训练集中的具有活性支持的 ChEMBL 化合物，以及13,500个留作测试的肽环。对于筛选化合物库化学，指纹误差中位数、Pearson r 和成对排序准确率分别为0.008、0.980和0.936；对于环肽，分别为0.016、0.984和0.952；对于具有活性支持的 ChEMBL 化合物，分别为0.027、0.936和0.889。参考计算自身重现时的误差为0.006、r 为0.995。因此，可仅从二维结构预测集合药效团指纹，成本适用于大规模化合物库筛选和虚拟化合物库探索。关键词：pharmacophore，fingerprint，scaffold hopping，surrogate model，virtual screening，applicability domain。

items.title: TabBench-Bio: A Living Benchmark for Machine Learning on High-Dimensional Biomedical Tables
items.abstract_or_text: Biomedical tables often combine thousands of measured variables with only tens or hundreds of labelled samples, a regime that is poorly represented in general-purpose tabular benchmarks. We introduce TabBench-Bio, a living and interactive benchmark of 43 biomedical datasets spanning multiple domains. Under a shared cross-validation protocol, we compare classical estimators, neural networks, and tabular foundation models across 28 feature-by-sample operating points. At the reference cell of 10,000 features and 100 training samples, RealTabPFN v2.5 has the highest point estimate, followed by Logistic Regression and TabDPT, whose point estimates are nearly identical. A paired bootstrap over the target pool separates RealTabPFN v2.5 from Logistic Regression by 145 Elo (95% interval [59, 232]). Tabular foundation models generally occupy the leading ranks, while the strongest configuration depends on the operating point and biomedical modality. The AutoML framework AutoGluon, using its one-hour "extreme" preset, is configured as a separate resource-intensive reference and is reported here at the reference cell. Fold-level predictions, run status, and deterministic aggregations make every reported result reproducible and reusable. We invite the community to contribute: TabBench-Bio is designed to grow, and we welcome submissions of new biomedical tabular datasets, particularly from underrepresented assays and clinical endpoints, for inclusion in future releases. The interactive leaderboard is available at: https://tabbench-bio.eu
items.summary_zh: TabBench-Bio建立覆盖43个数据集、28种特征—样本量工作点的交互式生物医学表格学习基准，并公开逐折预测与确定性汇总。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接针对高维、小样本生物医学表格这一常见但代表不足的设定，且可复现输出有助于比较模型而非仅比较单点分数。
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学表格通常将数千个测量变量与仅数十或数百个有标签样本结合，这一机制在通用表格基准中代表不足。我们提出TabBench-Bio：一个覆盖多个领域、由43个生物医学数据集组成的持续更新且交互式基准。在统一的交叉验证协议下，我们在28个特征数—样本数工作点上比较经典估计器、神经网络和表格基础模型。在10,000个特征和100个训练样本的参考单元中，RealTabPFN v2.5具有最高点估计值；Logistic Regression和TabDPT紧随其后，二者的点估计几乎相同。对目标池进行的配对bootstrap显示，RealTabPFN v2.5相对Logistic Regression高145 Elo（95%区间[59, 232]）。表格基础模型总体上处于领先排名，但最强配置取决于工作点和生物医学模态。使用一小时“extreme”预设的AutoML框架AutoGluon被配置为单独的高资源参考，并在此处的参考单元中报告。逐折预测、运行状态和确定性聚合使每项报告结果均可复现和复用。我们邀请社区参与：TabBench-Bio旨在持续增长，欢迎提交新的生物医学表格数据集，尤其是来自代表不足的检测和临床终点的数据集，以纳入未来版本。交互式排行榜见：https://tabbench-bio.eu

items.title: ObGynLongBench: Revealing the Evidence-to-EHR Gap in Longitudinal EHR Decision-Making
items.abstract_or_text: The application of large language models (LLMs) to personalized medical assistants has garnered growing interest. However, existing medical benchmarks largely rely on static question answering with pre-selected evidence, leaving unclear whether LLMs can make reliable clinical decisions from real longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). To bridge this gap, we introduce ObGynLongBench, a rule-grounded long-context EHR benchmark for obstetric and gynecologic decision-making, comprising 1,500 clinical decision-point cases from 976 real pregnancy EHR histories and traceable rules. Each case is anchored to a patient, a pregnancy-timeline point, and a pre-decision information boundary, enabling Evidence-only, Visit-level EHR, and History-level EHR evaluation. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals a substantial Evidence-to-EHR Gap: models perform well when evidence is directly provided, but accuracy drops when evidence must be extracted from same-day records or full pre-decision EHR histories. Further analyses identify evidence utilization as a key bottleneck: performance decreases with longer EHR contexts and more complex evidence requirements, and earlier failures often predict later failures within the same patient history. Finally, active-search agents perform best among EHR access strategies, highlighting patient-specific evidence utilization as a central challenge for reliable personalized medical assistants. Resources are available at https://github.com/xiangjun2003/ObgynLongbench.
items.summary_zh: ObGynLongBench以976份真实妊娠EHR中的1,500个决策点病例，评估LLM从纵向病历中定位决策证据的能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准量化了直接提供证据与从真实纵向EHR检索证据之间的性能落差，为个体化医疗助手的评估提出了更接近实际的边界。
items.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）应用于个体化医疗助手日益受到关注。然而，现有医疗基准大多依赖具有预先选定证据的静态问答，因此尚不清楚LLM能否基于真实的纵向电子健康记录（EHR）做出可靠的临床决策。为弥合这一差距，我们提出ObGynLongBench：一个以规则为基础的长上下文EHR基准，用于产科和妇科决策；它由来自976份真实妊娠EHR病史的1,500个临床决策点病例及可追溯规则构成。每个病例都锚定于一名患者、妊娠时间线中的一个点和一个决策前信息边界，从而支持仅证据、就诊级EHR和病史级EHR评估。对17个LLM的评估揭示了显著的“证据到EHR差距”：当直接提供证据时模型表现良好，但当必须从当日记录或完整决策前EHR病史中提取证据时，准确率下降。进一步分析将证据利用识别为关键瓶颈：随着EHR上下文变长和证据要求更复杂，性能降低；同一患者病史中的早期失败往往预示后续失败。最后，在EHR访问策略中，主动搜索智能体表现最佳，凸显患者特异性证据利用是可靠个体化医疗助手面临的核心挑战。资源见：https://github.com/xiangjun2003/ObgynLongbench。
items.author_line: Jun Xiang, Zhijie Bao, Rong Hu, Kaizhou Qin, Wei Chen, Zhongyu Wei

items.title: CIT-CAD: Constraint Intent Tree-based CAD Code Generation and Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Natural-language Computer-Aided Design (CAD) code generation aims to turn design intent into executable and editable parametric programs. Large language models (LLMs) make this goal increasingly practical, but useful systems must preserve the construction process behind the rendered geometry. Existing benchmarks and methods mostly focus on how closely the generated CAD model matches the reference geometry, often using metrics such as Intersection over Union (IoU). Such metrics can miss errors in part decomposition, construction hierarchy, Boolean operations, sketch structure, and geometric relations. This gap calls for a representation that makes design intent explicit and lets a system check generated code against that intent. We propose CIT-CAD, a framework that infers a Constraint Intent Tree (CIT) from the input description to represent the intended entities, hierarchy, operations, and relations. The tree has two roles: it guides CAD code generation and defines expected constraints for verification. The framework extracts actual constraints from the generated program, compares them with the expected constraints, and uses mismatches to localize and repair design violations. Experiments show that the framework improves CAD generation performance, with larger gains on more complex multi-entity designs. By turning design intent into an explicit and checkable object, this work is the first attempt to move text-to-CAD generation beyond rendered-geometry matching toward construction-aware synthesis, verification, and repair.
items.summary_zh: CIT-CAD 把文本设计意图表示为 Constraint Intent Tree，并将其同时用于 CAD 代码生成、约束比对、错误定位和修复，避免只按渲染几何相似度评价。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把可执行参数化程序的结构约束转化为可检查对象，适合检验模型是否真正保留了构造逻辑。摘要称复杂多实体设计上的提升更大，但未提供具体数值。
items.abstract_zh: 自然语言计算机辅助设计（CAD）代码生成旨在将设计意图转化为可执行、可编辑的参数化程序。大语言模型（LLM）使这一目标日益可行，但有用的系统必须保留渲染几何背后的构造过程。现有基准和方法大多关注生成的 CAD 模型与参考几何的接近程度，通常使用交并比（IoU）等指标。这类指标可能遗漏零件分解、构造层级、布尔操作、草图结构和几何关系中的错误。这一缺口需要一种能使设计意图显式化，并让系统据此检查生成代码的表示。我们提出 CIT-CAD，一个从输入描述中推断 Constraint Intent Tree（CIT）的框架，用于表示预期的实体、层级、操作和关系。该树有两种作用：引导 CAD 代码生成，并定义用于验证的预期约束。该框架从生成的程序中提取实际约束，将其与预期约束比较，并利用不匹配来定位和修复设计违例。实验表明，该框架提高了 CAD 生成性能，且在更复杂的多实体设计中增益更大。通过将设计意图转化为显式且可检查的对象，这项工作首次尝试使文本到 CAD 的生成超越渲染几何匹配，转向面向构造的合成、验证和修复。
items.author_line: Yali Du, Hui Sun, San-Zhuo Xi, Ming Li

items.title: Scratchy: Visual-Scratchpad Multimodal Reasoning for Cryptographic Proof Generation in EasyCrypt
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) have recently made substantial progress in formal proof generation, yet presenting distinctive challenges in cryptographic area. Computational security arguments posit that a valid proof must coordinate probability, adversarial games, invariants, assumptions and bounds, which can be provided by a machine-checked framework named EasyCrypt. Although all objects may appear in available context, LLMs still struggle because proof-theoretic dependencies are typically implicit in a linear representation and distributed across multiple programs. So, this paper presents Scratchy, a visual-scratchpad approach that exposes these dependencies for multimodal generation. Given the natural-language security description, with formal context and target propositions, the proof objects can be normalized into a typed proof-relation graph. Then a structure-preserving visual compiler transforms the graph into the formula-rich visual proof state that guides a multimodal model in generating the EasyCrypt proof. Also, the Scratchy-eval, a 114-task dataset derived from reliable official EasyCrypt files, has been introduced. It contains 64 security-form proof generations and 50 multiple-choice knowledge tests. After a series of evaluations, covering semantic grounding, relational invariants, and game reductions, classical LLMs like GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 have gained a clear advantage from Scratchy's structured visual proof states. This contrast suggests that explicit proof structure can make the improvement and multimodal proof-state representation as a promising direction for computer-aided cryptography.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 密码学证明的正确性可由 EasyCrypt 机械检查。该工作把模型输入结构与最终可检验的证明对象连接起来；但摘要没有给出具体通过率，能力提升幅度仍需结合完整评测核查。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）近期在形式化证明生成方面取得了显著进展，但在密码学领域仍面临独特挑战。计算安全论证要求一个有效证明能够协调概率、对手博弈、不变量、假设和界，而这些内容可由名为 EasyCrypt 的机器检查框架提供。尽管所有对象都可能出现在可用上下文中，LLM 仍然困难重重，因为证明论依赖通常隐含于线性表示中，并分散在多个程序之间。因此，本文提出 Scratchy：一种为多模态生成显式呈现这些依赖关系的视觉草稿板方法。给定自然语言安全描述、形式化上下文和目标命题，证明对象可被规范化为类型化证明关系图。随后，一个保持结构的视觉编译器将该图转换为富含公式的视觉证明状态，以引导多模态模型生成 EasyCrypt 证明。此外，本文引入 Scratchy-eval——一个由可靠的官方 EasyCrypt 文件构建的 114 任务数据集，其中包括 64 个安全形式的证明生成任务和 50 个多项选择知识测试。经过涵盖语义落地、关系不变量和博弈归约的一系列评测，GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-5 等经典 LLM 从 Scratchy 的结构化视觉证明状态中获得了明显优势。这一对比表明，显式证明结构能够带来改进，而多模态证明状态表示是计算机辅助密码学的一个有前景方向。

items.title: BigMixSolDB: Extraction of a solubility database in solvent mixtures with an uncertainty-quantified large language model-based pipeline
items.abstract_or_text: The rapidly expanding body of chemical literature contains physical data scattered across unstructured text and complex tables in thousands of publications. Translating this information into machine-readable formats is essential for training data-driven chemical models. The lack of uncertainty quantification in computationally extracted datasets makes manual extraction and curation still necessary. We here address this challenge and present an uncertainty-quantified data extraction pipeline. Our fully automated pipeline utilizes large language models (LLMs) to extract complex tabular and textual chemical data directly from scientific PDFs. We systematically assess several modern LLMs and document-to-text conversion frameworks. We benchmark the uncertainty in extracted data by comparison of our computationally extracted databases with large, existing databases on solubility that are manually curated. Our pipeline achieves between 93 and 79% of the literature contained data, with near-zero median log deviations for structurally matched rows and residual high-magnitude errors concentrated in a small subset of OCR, table-structure, unit-scaling, or reference-dataset discrepancies. We showcase the utility of our pipeline by deploying it to extract data from over 2,000 articles and generate BigMixSolDB, a comprehensive database on solubility in complex mixtures. BigMixSolDB comprises 280,273 solubility entries spanning single, binary, and ternary solvent systems. Our results demonstrate how integrated LLM-based pipelines can be used for literature data extraction that is comparable with manual curation. We envision that these frameworks can be used for large-scale, accurate extraction of literature data into datasets for machine learning applications

items.abstract_zh: 快速扩展的化学文献主体包含分散在数千篇出版物的非结构化文本和复杂表格中的物理数据。将这些信息转换为机器可读格式，对于训练数据驱动的化学模型至关重要。计算抽取数据集缺乏不确定性量化，意味着人工抽取和整理仍是必要的。我们在此应对这一挑战，并提出一种带不确定性量化的数据抽取流程。我们的全自动流程利用大语言模型（LLMs）直接从科学 PDF 中抽取复杂的表格和文本化学数据。我们系统评估了数种现代 LLM 和 document-to-text 转换框架。我们通过将计算抽取的数据库与大型、现有的人工整理溶解度数据库比较，来评测抽取数据的不确定性。我们的流程达到文献中所含数据的93%至79%，对于结构匹配的行，log 偏差中位数接近零；残余的大幅误差集中在少量 OCR、表格结构、单位缩放或参考数据集差异中。我们通过将该流程部署于从超过2,000篇文章中抽取数据，展示了其效用，并生成 BigMixSolDB——一个关于复杂混合物中溶解度的综合数据库。BigMixSolDB 包含280,273条溶解度记录，涵盖单一、二元和三元溶剂体系。我们的结果表明，整合的基于 LLM 的流程可用于从文献中大规模、准确地抽取数据，其表现可与人工整理相比。我们设想这些框架可用于将文献中的数据大规模、准确地抽取为可供机器学习应用的数据集。

items.title: Chemical Accuracy for Carbapenem Breakdown by Class A beta-Lactamases Using a Transferable Embedded Machine-Learned Potential
items.abstract_or_text: Bacterial resistance to carbapenems (potent β-lactam antibiotics) is a critical global health threat. The primary cause is β-lactamase enzymes that hydrolyze antibiotics. Previously, carbapenems resisted breakdown, making them ‘last resort’ antibiotics, but enzymes with carbapenemase activity have become widespread. Understanding and predicting the activity of β-lactamases will help in developing antibiotics and inhibitors, and combating antibiotic resistance. Effective prediction requires methods that are both accurate and computationally efficient. Multiscale combined quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) molecular dynamics simulations of reactions can discriminate between class A β-lactamases (the most widely distributed group) with or without carbapenemase activity, and identify determinants of activity. but face an accuracy/efficiency tradeoff: approximate semiempirical QM methods do not predict reaction barriers accurately, but higher level QM calculations require extensive computer time and resources, making them impractical for rapid predictions. Here, we develop and test a transferable ML/MM framework for the deacylation reaction of the carbapenem meropenem, using the electrostatic machine learning embedding (EMLE) scheme. This model gives free energy barriers to within 1 kcal/mol of values derived from experiment, for four different class A β-lactamases. Crucially, the model was trained only on active site structures from QM/MM simulations of a single enzyme. It did not require retraining to generalize across Class A β-lactamases. It is both faster and more accurate than semi-empirical QM/MM simulations. The ML/MM simulations capture the structural and electrostatic determinants of carbapenemase activity, including oxyanion stabilization and active site electric fields, that differ between enzymes. This work establishes transferable EMLE-based ML/MM simulation as a practical route for accurate, efficient modelling of enzyme-catalyzed reactions.
items.summary_zh: 开发可迁移的 EMLE ML/MM 框架模拟 meropenem 在 A 类 β-lactamases 中的脱酰化；模型仅在一种酶的 QM/MM 构象上训练，报告在四种酶中自由能垒与实验值相差不超过1 kcal/mol。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在不为每种酶重新训练的条件下兼顾 QM/MM 级准确性与效率，有助于研究 carbapenemase 活性及抑制剂设计；验证范围限于四种 A 类 β-lactamases 和一个底物反应。
items.abstract_zh: 细菌对 carbapenems（强效 β-lactam antibiotics）的耐药性是一项严峻的全球健康威胁。其主要原因是能够水解抗生素的 β-lactamase 酶。此前，carbapenems 能抵抗分解，因此被视为“最后防线”抗生素，但具有 carbapenemase 活性的酶已广泛传播。理解和预测 β-lactamases 的活性将有助于开发抗生素和抑制剂，并应对抗生素耐药性。有效预测需要同时准确且计算高效的方法。反应的多尺度量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）分子动力学模拟能够区分具有或不具有 carbapenemase 活性的 A 类 β-lactamases（分布最广的一类），并识别活性的决定因素，但面临准确性/效率权衡：近似半经验 QM 方法不能准确预测反应势垒，而更高层级的 QM 计算需要大量计算时间和资源，使其不适合快速预测。这里，我们使用 electrostatic machine learning embedding（EMLE）方案，为 carbapenem meropenem 的脱酰化反应开发并测试了一个可迁移的 ML/MM 框架。对于四种不同的 A 类 β-lactamases，该模型给出的自由能垒与实验推导值相差在1 kcal/mol以内。关键的是，该模型仅使用来自一种酶的 QM/MM 模拟活性位点结构训练。它无需重新训练即可泛化到不同的 A 类 β-lactamases。它比半经验 QM/MM 模拟更快且更准确。ML/MM 模拟捕捉了不同酶之间的 carbapenemase 活性的结构和静电决定因素，包括氧阴离子稳定化和活性位点电场。该工作确立了基于 EMLE 的 ML/MM 模拟作为准确、高效建模酶催化反应的实用路径。

items.title: FUSED: A Functional Representation for Joint Structural and Elemental Analysis of Protein Ligand Binding Sites
items.abstract_or_text: Ligand binding site representations are central to the analysis of protein-ligand interactions, with applications in functional characterization, binding-site comparison, and ligand recognition. Many descriptor-based approaches characterize ligand binding sites using a fixed distance threshold from the ligand, despite substantial variability in how such thresholds are defined and the possibility that relevant structural and compositional information changes across spatial scales. We propose Functional Unification of Structural and Elemental Descriptors (FUSED), a multivariate functional representation that jointly models structural and elemental compositional information of ligand binding sites as functions of distance from the ligand. Structural information is captured through covariance-based descriptors derived from the CDPA framework, while chemical composition is represented through isometric log-ratio coordinates to account appropriately for compositional geometry. Treating distance from the ligand as a functional domain allows structural and compositional characteristics to be examined across distance thresholds rather than at a single prespecified value. The resulting representation can be used directly or combined with dimension-reduction, statistical-learning, and/or machine-learning procedures, with the distance interval tailored to the dataset, analytical task, and procedure. We evaluate FUSED on three benchmark datasets spanning complementary ligand binding-site analysis tasks: the Extended Kahraman dataset for multiclass ligand discrimination, TOUGH-C1 for binary binding-site classification, and TOUGH-M1 for pairwise matching of pockets associated with drug-like ligands. FUSED supports strong discrimination in the EK and TOUGH-C1 tasks using standard statistical-learning procedures, while a supervised Siamese neural network applied to the full FUSED representation achieves a mean ROC-AUC of 0.9375 on TOUGH-M1 under repeated sequence-cluster-disjoint evaluation, approaching the strongest reported benchmark performance. These results demonstrate that FUSED provides a flexible, alignment-free representation that supports both direct examination of threshold-dependent binding-site characteristics and competitive downstream classification and pocket matching while remaining computationally practical.
items.summary_zh: FUSED 将蛋白–配体结合位点的协方差结构描述符与元素组成的等距对数比坐标，建模为配体距离的函数；在 EK、TOUGH-C1 和 TOUGH-M1 基准上进行分类和口袋匹配评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 不再固定单一口袋截断阈值的函数式表示，可同时保留结构和化学组成随空间尺度变化的信息；优势目前主要由既有基准衡量，能否改善下游药物发现仍待实证。
items.abstract_zh: 配体结合位点表示是蛋白质–配体相互作用分析的核心，应用于功能表征、结合位点比较和配体识别。许多基于描述符的方法使用距配体的固定距离阈值来表征配体结合位点，尽管此类阈值的定义差异很大，并且相关的结构和组成信息可能随空间尺度改变。我们提出 Functional Unification of Structural and Elemental Descriptors（FUSED），一种多变量函数表示，将配体结合位点的结构和元素组成信息共同建模为距配体的函数。结构信息通过源自 CDPA 框架的协方差描述符获取，而化学组成通过等距对数比坐标表示，以恰当地处理组成几何。将距配体的距离作为函数域，可在不同距离阈值上而非单一预先指定的值考察结构和组成特征。所得表示可直接使用，也可与降维、统计学习和/或机器学习程序结合；距离区间可针对数据集、分析任务和程序定制。我们在三个覆盖互补配体结合位点分析任务的基准数据集上评估 FUSED：用于多类配体区分的 Extended Kahraman 数据集、用于二元结合位点分类的 TOUGH-C1，以及用于与药物样配体相关口袋成对匹配的 TOUGH-M1。FUSED 使用标准统计学习程序在 EK 和 TOUGH-C1 任务中支持强判别；而应用于完整 FUSED 表示的有监督 Siamese neural network，在重复的序列簇不重叠评估下，在 TOUGH-M1 上达到平均 ROC-AUC 0.9375，接近已报告的最强基准性能。这些结果表明，FUSED 提供了一种灵活、免对齐的表示，在保持计算实用性的同时，支持直接考察依赖阈值的结合位点特征，以及具有竞争力的下游分类和口袋匹配。

items.title: Contrastive Reward Based Reinforcement Learning for Goal Directed 3D Molecular Design
items.abstract_or_text: Although three-dimensional flow-matching models have become powerful tools for efficient sampling of high-quality 3D molecular structures, reward-based reinforcement learning for flow-matching models is complicated by the absence of a tractable trajectory likelihood for hybrid molecular states comprising categorical features and continuous coordinates. Existing policy-optimization strategies address this difficulty by stochasticizing the generative process or constructing likelihood surrogates, introducing additional approximations. Here, we present ReCoFlow, a novel trajectorylikelihood-free reinforcement learning framework for reward-contrastive post-training of pretrained molecular flow-matching models. Within ReCoFlow, reward-favored molecules provide positive endpoint supervision for the flow-matching model, whereas reward-disfavored molecules are used to construct reference-guided negative targets. Additionally, an anchor loss to an exponential moving average (EMA) reference model constrains the drift of the fine-tuned model. In benchmarking studies including physicochemical property optimization, three-dimensional shape optimization, and pocket-conditioned 3D molecular generation, ReCoFlow consistently improved the performance of flow-matching models over reward-weighted and surrogate-ratio optimization schemes while maintaining high molecular validity. These results suggest that ReCoFlow could be an effective reinforcement-learning strategy for goal-directed molecular design.
items.summary_zh: ReCoFlow 为预训练3D molecular flow-matching 模型提出无轨迹似然的奖励对比后训练：高奖励终点作正监督、低奖励终点构造参考引导负目标，并以 EMA 锚定损失限制模型漂移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对混合离散/连续分子状态中强化学习难以获得轨迹似然的问题，提出避免额外似然近似的优化方案；结论来自计算基准，奖励函数设定与合成可行性尚未由实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管三维 flow-matching 模型已成为高效采样高质量3D 分子结构的强大工具，但对于由类别特征和连续坐标构成的混合分子状态，基于奖励的 flow-matching 模型强化学习因缺乏可处理的轨迹似然而变得复杂。现有策略通过将生成过程随机化或构建似然替代物来应对这一困难，但会引入额外近似。这里，我们提出 ReCoFlow，一种新颖的无轨迹似然强化学习框架，用于对预训练分子 flow-matching 模型进行基于奖励对比的后训练。在 ReCoFlow 中，奖励偏好的分子为 flow-matching 模型提供正终点监督，而奖励不偏好的分子用于构建参考引导的负目标。此外，对指数移动平均（EMA）参考模型的锚定损失限制了微调模型的漂移。在包括物理化学性质优化、三维形状优化和口袋条件三维分子生成的基准研究中，ReCoFlow 在保持高分子有效性的同时，持续优于奖励加权和替代比率优化方案。这些结果表明，ReCoFlow 可能是一种用于目标导向分子设计的有效强化学习策略。

items.title: Sensitive Glioma Detection and Recurrence Monitoring Using a Machine Learning Model Based on Circulating Monocytes
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Glioma induces profound systemic immune alterations despite its anatomical confinement to the central nervous system. Circulating immune cells, particularly monocytes, are key mediators of tumor-host crosstalk and may retain tumor-induced transcriptional imprints. However, their potential clinical utility as blood-based biomarkers for detection and monitoring, remain largely unexplored. Methods and findings: In this study, we performed integrated single-cell RNA sequencing of blood immune cells and demonstrated that circulating CD14 monocytes are significantly expanded in glioma patients, exhibiting features of differentiation arrest and increased transcriptional plasticity. These cells harbor glioma-specific molecular signatures distinct from those observed in healthy controls and patients with other tumors. Leveraging these findings, we developed an ensemble machine learning diagnostic model based on transcriptomic profiles of circulating CD14 monocytes (training cohort, n=107), which achieved a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.975 during cross-validation. In an independent cohort of 567 participants, the model maintained high diagnostic accuracy, yielding an AUC of 0.888 for distinguishing glioma from controls and other tumors. And it achieved a recurrence detection AUC of 0.975 in 51 postoperative samples. Moreover, in a follow-up study involving 30 glioma patients, lower model-derived scores of postoperation were significantly associated with prolonged progression-free survival (log-rank test, P=0.034), supporting its prognostic utility. Conclusion: We demonstrate circulating CD14 monocytes undergo glioma-specific transcriptional reprogramming, generating systemic tumor-associated signal captured via transcriptomic profiling. This blood-based diagnostic model provides non-invasive, scalable approach for glioma detection, recurrence surveillance, outcome prediction.
items.summary_zh: 研究以循环CD14单核细胞转录组训练集成模型，在独立队列中评估胶质瘤检测和术后复发检测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 单细胞机制观察与567人独立队列相结合，使其成为有临床转化潜力的血液标志物预印本；仍需进一步前瞻性、多中心验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：尽管胶质瘤在解剖学上局限于中枢神经系统，它仍会诱发深刻的全身免疫改变。循环免疫细胞，尤其是单核细胞，是肿瘤—宿主串扰的关键介质，并可能保留肿瘤诱导的转录印记。然而，它们作为用于检测和监测的血液生物标志物的潜在临床效用仍在很大程度上未被探索。方法和发现：在本研究中，我们对血液免疫细胞进行了整合单细胞RNA测序，证明循环CD14单核细胞在胶质瘤患者中显著扩增，并表现出分化停滞和转录可塑性增强的特征。这些细胞携带胶质瘤特异性分子特征，与健康对照者和其他肿瘤患者中观察到的特征不同。利用这些发现，我们开发了一种基于循环CD14单核细胞转录组谱的集成机器学习诊断模型（训练队列n=107），其在交叉验证中的平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）达到0.975。在包含567名参与者的独立队列中，该模型仍维持较高诊断准确性，在区分胶质瘤与对照及其他肿瘤时AUC为0.888；在51份术后样本中，复发检测AUC为0.975。此外，在一项涉及30名胶质瘤患者的随访研究中，术后较低的模型衍生评分与更长的无进展生存期显著相关（log-rank检验，P=0.034），支持其预后效用。结论：我们表明循环CD14单核细胞经历胶质瘤特异性的转录重编程，产生可由转录组分析捕获的全身性肿瘤相关信号。该基于血液的诊断模型为胶质瘤检测、复发监测和结局预测提供了一种无创、可扩展的方法。

items.title: Evaluating Few-Shot Meta-Learning using STUNT for Microbiome-Based Disease Classification
items.abstract_or_text: The human gut microbiome is increasingly explored as a diagnostic indicator for disease, yet machine learning models trained on metagenomic data are often constrained by limited sample sizes and poor cross-cohort generalizability. Meta-learning, a machine learning paradigm that optimizes models for rapid adaptation to new tasks with limited examples, offers a promising strategy to address this by leveraging the potential shared microbial structure across publicly available metagenomic datasets. Here, we evaluated STUNT, a framework combining self-supervised pretraining with metric-based meta-learning (Prototypical Networks), for few-shot microbiome-based disease classification. Using over 5,000 species-level gut metagenomic profiles from 57 cohorts in GMrepo v2, we meta-trained STUNT on 52 cohorts and evaluated the pretrained embedding on five held-out disease cohorts covering rheumatoid arthritis (RA), gestational diabetes mellitus during pregnancy (GDM), non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), diabetes mellitus, type 1 (T1D), and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). We compared Prototypical Networks, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest with and without STUNT-derived embeddings across shot sizes of 1 to 10 samples per class. We found that STUNT-derived embeddings provided a modest benefit only under extreme data scarcity (one labeled sample per class) and this advantage rapidly diminished and reversed with additional samples, indicating that the meta-learned representations impose an information bottleneck limiting access to task-specific signals. Classification performance varied substantially across cohorts, consistent with PERMANOVA-estimated microbiome-disease separability. These results highlight the need for representation learning approaches that preserve disease- and cohort-specific variation and suggest that intrinsic biological signal strength is the primary determinant of classification success.
items.summary_zh: 研究在GMrepo v2的57个队列、5,000余份肠道宏基因组谱上评估STUNT少样本元学习，并报告其优势仅限于极端数据稀缺情形。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个有价值的负向/边界结果：跨队列表征学习并非随样本增加而持续获益，疾病与队列特异信号仍是关键限制。
items.abstract_zh: 人类肠道微生物组日益被探索为疾病的诊断指标，但在宏基因组数据上训练的机器学习模型常受限于样本量小和跨队列泛化性差。元学习是一种优化模型以利用少量样本快速适应新任务的机器学习范式；它通过利用公开宏基因组数据集中潜在的共享微生物结构，为解决这一问题提供了有前景的策略。这里，我们评估了STUNT：一个将自监督预训练与基于度量的元学习（Prototypical Networks）相结合、用于基于微生物组疾病分类的框架。我们使用GMrepo v2中来自57个队列的5,000多份物种水平肠道宏基因组谱，在52个队列上对STUNT进行元训练，并在5个留出的疾病队列上评估预训练嵌入，这些队列涵盖类风湿关节炎（RA）、妊娠期妊娠糖尿病（GDM）、非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）、1型糖尿病（T1D）和炎症性肠病（IBD）。我们在每类1至10个样本的shot数范围内，比较了使用和不使用STUNT衍生嵌入的Prototypical Networks、Logistic Regression和Random Forest。我们发现，STUNT衍生嵌入仅在极端数据稀缺条件下（每类1个有标签样本）提供适度益处；随着样本增多，这一优势迅速减弱并反转，表明元学习表示施加了信息瓶颈，限制了对任务特异信号的访问。分类性能在不同队列间差异很大，与PERMANOVA估计的微生物组—疾病可分离性一致。这些结果强调，需要采用能保留疾病和队列特异性变异的表示学习方法，并表明内在生物学信号强度是分类成功的主要决定因素。

items.title: Toward De Novo Protein Design from Natural Language
items.abstract_or_text: Programming biological function-designing bespoke proteins to perform specified molecular tasks-is a foundational goal of molecular engineering. However, current design paradigms remain fundamentally limited: they typically require either natural proteins as starting points for optimization or manual reformulation of functional goals as geometric and sequence-level constraints to guide candidate generation. Here we introduce Pinal, a 16-billion-parameter foundation model that designs candidate proteins from natural-language descriptions of desired function. Trained on 1.7 billion synthetically annotated protein-text pairs, Pinal links functional intent to protein sequence and structure. In computational evaluations, generated candidates combined high predicted foldability with functional-description alignment and sequence diversity, providing a basis for prioritizing experimentally testable designs. We applied Pinal to four distinct design tasks-a fluorescent protein, a polyethylene terephthalate hydrolase, an alcohol dehydrogenase and a metabolic H-protein-and experimentally observed the intended function in each case, including catalytic activity for both designed enzymes. Crucially, without iterative experimental optimization, a Pinal-designed H-protein increased product titer by 1.7-fold relative to the corresponding native E. coli H-protein in a multi-enzyme CO2 fixation pathway. These findings support natural language as a high-level interface for candidate generation in protein design, enabling programmable exploration with reduced reliance on manually specified structural or sequence constraints.
items.summary_zh: 提出160亿参数的 Pinal，将自然语言功能描述映射为蛋白质序列和结构；在荧光蛋白、PET 水解酶、醇脱氢酶及代谢 H-protein 四项任务中均报告了目标功能实验结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把高层功能意图直接作为蛋白设计接口，并给出多类功能的实验验证；训练数据为合成标注的 protein–text 对，功能描述对真实可设计性的泛化范围仍需审慎评估。

items.abstract_zh: 对生物功能进行编程——设计执行指定分子任务的定制蛋白质——是分子工程的一个基础目标。然而，当前设计范式仍受到根本性限制：它们通常需要以天然蛋白质为优化起点，或将功能目标手动重述为几何与序列层面的约束，以指导候选物生成。我们在此提出 Pinal，一个160亿参数的基础模型，可根据所需功能的自然语言描述设计候选蛋白质。Pinal 在17亿个合成标注的 protein–text 对上训练，将功能意图与蛋白质序列和结构关联起来。在计算评估中，生成的候选物同时具有较高的预测可折叠性、与功能描述的一致性以及序列多样性，为优先选择可进行实验检验的设计提供了基础。我们将 Pinal 应用于四项不同的设计任务——荧光蛋白、polyethylene terephthalate hydrolase、alcohol dehydrogenase 和 metabolic H-protein——并在每项任务中实验观察到预期功能，其中两种设计酶均具有催化活性。关键的是，在无需迭代实验优化的情况下，一个 Pinal 设计的 H-protein 在多酶 CO2 固定通路中使产物滴度相对于相应的天然 E. coli H-protein 提高了1.7倍。这些发现支持将自然语言作为蛋白设计中候选物生成的高层接口，从而以更少依赖人工指定的结构或序列约束的方式，实现可编程的探索。

items.title: A glass-box foundation model for density functional theory
items.abstract_or_text: Machine-learned exchange–correlation functionals promise accuracy beyond traditional forms, yet so far they trade interpretability for flexibility. Here we introduce DL-xDH26, a glass-box foundation model for density functional development on the fifth rung of Jacob’s ladder, with separate exchange and correlation expert towers, interpretable enhancement-factor and shift parameters relative to a physical base, and exact degree-one homogeneity. Trained exclusively on relative energies, it recovers atomic exchange and correlation energies and their quantum shell structure, and produces smooth, size-consistent dissociation curves without dispersion corrections, while reaching errors below 1 kcal/mol on the GMTKN55 and MGCDB84 benchmark suites. Lightweight fine-tuning then specializes the same backbone to cyclization reactions, distorted organic geometries, and organometallic reaction energetics while retaining its broad accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 提出可解释的第五阶 DFT 基础模型 DL-xDH26，以独立的交换与相关专家塔、相对物理基线可解释参数及精确一阶齐次性学习交换-相关泛函；在 GMTKN55 和 MGCDB84 上报告低于1 kcal/mol误差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若结果可复现，该模型把机器学习泛函的精度与物理可解释性、尺寸一致性结合，可用于反应与有机金属能量计算；基准集表现和微调收益尚需独立评测。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习的交换-相关泛函有望达到超越传统形式的精度，但迄今为止，它们以可解释性换取了灵活性。我们在此介绍 DL-xDH26：一个用于 Jacob’s ladder 第五阶密度泛函发展的玻璃盒基础模型，具有独立的交换和相关专家塔、相对于物理基线的可解释增强因子和位移参数，以及精确的一阶齐次性。该模型仅在相对能量上训练，却能恢复原子交换和相关能及其量子壳层结构；无需色散校正即可生成平滑、尺寸一致的解离曲线，同时在 GMTKN55 和 MGCDB84 基准套件上达到低于1 kcal/mol的误差。随后，轻量微调可将同一骨干网络专门用于环化反应、扭曲有机几何和有机金属反应能量，同时保留其广泛的准确性。
