items.title: Fast-Response Operando Mass Spectrometry Demystifies C₂ Product Formation in Cu-Catalyzed CO and CO₂ Reduction: Burst of Ethylene Isotopologues
items.abstract_or_text: It has been a long-standing challenge in electrocatalysis to measure product formation with kinetically relevant time resolution. Here, we couple a real-time gas analyzer mass spectrometer with a modified sampling inlet to a gas diffusion electrode cell, achieving sub-second time resolution for both reactant consumption and product formation. We focus on CO 2 /CO reduction on oxide-derived Cu, motivated by the continuing interest in its reaction mechanism and its high selectivity to ethylene (C 2 H 4 ) formation. Potential step experiments for CO reduction reveal that the initial consumption of CO is fast ( 2 H 4 products can be 10 times slower, which we attribute to the time required for CO storage on the Cu surface and subsequent reconstruction into the active, C 2+ -forming, configuration. Previous studies have reported that the co-feed of 12 CO 2 / 13 CO results in the enhancement of 13 C-containing ethylene isotopologues, but the mechanism causing this remains unknown. Isotopic-labeled gas switching ( 12 CO 2 - 13 CO) experiments yield compelling evidence that 13 C species continue to exist for more than a minute at near proximity to or on the catalyst, even after the supply source has been cut off, evidenced by the significant enhancement of 13 C-containing ethylene isotopologues: pure ( 13 C 2 H 4 ) and mixed ( 13 C 12 CH 4 ), formed through a CO 2 (g)-*CO pathway. Importantly, the size of the C 1 reservoir, the amount of 13 C 12 CH 4 made when CO 2 reacts with it, and the amount of Cu + that is removed are all in the micromole range. Thus, the picture emerges that a monolayer is stripped off from the copper catalyst surface during the CO-CO 2 switch. Tracking of dynamic Cu surface insights (i.e., activation, dissolution and deactivation) provides valuable mechanistic insights for optimizing reaction conditions.
items.summary_zh: 将快速响应在线质谱接入气体扩散电极电池，以亚秒时间分辨率追踪氧化物衍生 Cu 上 CO/CO2 还原；同位素切换结果指向近表面 13C 储库、表面重构及 C2 产物形成之间的动态耦合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 直接时间分辨的产物和反应物读出为 Cu 电催化 C2 选择性机理提供了较强实验约束，可指导动态工况优化；储库和表面剥离的机理解释仍应由正交表征进一步检验。
evidence_flags: 机制解释待进一步验证
items.abstract_zh: 在电催化中，以具有动力学相关性的时间分辨率测量产物形成一直是一项长期挑战。这里，我们将实时气体分析质谱仪与改进的取样入口耦合至气体扩散电极电池，实现了对反应物消耗和产物形成的亚秒时间分辨率。我们聚焦于氧化物衍生 Cu 上的 CO2/CO 还原，这是因为人们持续关注其反应机制及其对乙烯（C2H4）形成的高选择性。CO 还原的电势阶跃实验表明，初始 CO 消耗很快，而 C2H4 产物的形成可慢10倍；我们将其归因于 CO 在 Cu 表面储存以及随后重构为活性、形成 C2+ 的构型所需的时间。先前研究报道，12CO2/13CO 共进料会增强含13C 的乙烯同位素体，但导致这一现象的机制未知。同位素标记气体切换（12CO2–13CO）实验提供了有力证据：即使供应源已被切断，13C 物种仍在催化剂附近或表面存在超过一分钟；显著增强的含13C 乙烯同位素体——纯13C2H4和混合13C12CH4——即为证据，这些产物经由 CO2(g)-*CO 路径形成。重要的是，C1 储库的大小、CO2 与其反应时形成的13C12CH4 的量，以及被移除的 Cu+ 的量，都处于微摩尔范围。因此，出现了这样一幅图景：在 CO–CO2 切换期间，铜催化剂表面的一层单层被剥离。对动态 Cu 表面洞见（即活化、溶解和失活）的追踪，为优化反应条件提供了有价值的机制洞见。
items.author_line: Helen J. Zeng, Yesol Kim, Junko Yano, Joel W. Ager

items.title: Physical Metallurgy of Lithium and Sodium and its Role in Electrochemical Stability of Solid-State Battery Anodes
items.abstract_or_text: Alkali metal negative electrodes in solid-state batteries (SSBs) undergo mechanical deformation during cycling, for which an understanding of their physical metallurgy is critical. Here, we study the link between microstructure and plastic deformation in lithium and sodium. Grain size is controlled through deformation processing, and etching methods are developed to reveal grain boundaries, subgrain boundaries, and dislocation structures. Hall-Petch strengthening with decreasing grain size occurs in both metals. Creep rate in lithium is grain-size-independent above the subgrain size, but increases at small grain sizes where diffusional creep dominates. Oxide dispersion-strengthened behavior is observed in Li. At length scales below the subgrain size, strength increases and creep rates decrease due to dislocation starvation. Solid-state electrochemical cell tests in which lithium of differing foil thickness is stripped under pressure validates length-scale effects. Overall, this work provides a physical metallurgy framework for alkali metal deformation and offers design principles for advanced SSBs.
items.summary_zh: 系统研究 Li 和 Na 的晶粒尺寸、位错结构、蠕变与强化，并通过受压剥离的固态电化学电池测试验证长度尺度效应，为固态电池金属负极设计给出冶金学框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把基础塑性变形机制与真实固态电池测试相连，可指导机械稳定的 Li/Na 负极开发；具体设计准则能否跨电解质、界面和长期循环条件迁移仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 固态电池（SSBs）中的碱金属负极在循环过程中发生机械变形，因此理解其物理冶金学至关重要。这里，我们研究了微观结构与锂和钠塑性变形之间的联系。通过变形加工控制晶粒尺寸，并开发蚀刻方法以揭示晶界、亚晶界和位错结构。两种金属均表现出随晶粒尺寸减小而发生的 Hall-Petch 强化。在亚晶粒尺寸以上，锂的蠕变速率与晶粒尺寸无关；但在小晶粒尺寸下，扩散蠕变占主导，蠕变速率增加。Li 中观察到氧化物弥散强化行为。在低于亚晶粒尺寸的长度尺度上，由于位错饥饿，强度增加而蠕变速率降低。使用不同箔厚锂在压力下剥离的固态电化学电池测试验证了长度尺度效应。总体而言，本工作为碱金属变形提供了物理冶金学框架，并为先进 SSBs 提供了设计原则。
items.author_line: Chiung-Yuan Lo, Vijay D. Veeraraghavan, Cole D. Fincher, Callum J. Campbell, QianQian Yan, David Mitlin, Yet-Ming Chiang

items.title: Synthesis of 15N-Labelled Complex Saturated N-Heterocycles via Late-Stage Carbonyl-to-Nitrogen Swap
items.abstract_or_text: ‡Process Research and Development, Merck & Co., Rahway, New Jersey 07065, United States ABSTRACT: Efficient construction of 15N-labelled complex saturated N-heterocycles remains a substantial challenge. Here we report a late-stage carbonyl-to-15N skeletal modification strategy that converts complex cyclic ketones directly into 15Nenriched saturated heterocycles. This transformation is enabled by a methylsulfonyl-based 15N-labelled azonation reagent that suppresses unwanted overoxidation without compromising the desired C-C bond cleavage pathway. The reaction exhibits a broad substrate scope and tolerates a wide range of functional groups, serving as an effective tool for late-stage skeletal modifications of complex natural products and drug-like molecules. Mechanistic insights on the sequential double C–C activation events have been elucidated by preliminary computational studies.
items.summary_zh: 报道利用 methylsulfonyl-based 15N-labelled azonation reagent 的晚期 carbonyl-to-15N 骨架编辑，将复杂环酮转化为 15N-enriched 饱和杂环，并展示官能团耐受性与药物样分子适用性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为同位素标记复杂含氮骨架提供了可用于药物代谢和机制研究的晚期改造路线；摘要未给出完整收率、底物数或同位素掺入率，适用边界需查看全文。
items.abstract_zh: 高效构建15N 标记的复杂饱和 N-杂环仍是一项重大挑战。我们在此报道一种晚期 carbonyl-to-15N 骨架修饰策略，可将复杂环酮直接转化为15N 富集的饱和杂环。该转化由一种基于 methylsulfonyl 的15N 标记 azonation reagent 实现；该试剂抑制不需要的过氧化，同时不损害所需的 C-C 键断裂路径。该反应具有广泛的底物范围，并耐受多种官能团，可作为复杂天然产物和药物样分子晚期骨架修饰的有效工具。关于连续双 C–C 活化事件的机制认识已由初步计算研究阐明。
items.author_line: Zining Zhang, Seoung-Tae Kim, Jingwei Li, Guangbin Dong

items.title: CellART: a unified framework for extracting single-cell information from high-resolution spatial transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding how different cell types assemble into tissues and organs, as well as how they interact to transmit and receive biological signals, is essential for advancing biomedical and biological research. Recent advancements in spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies have opened new avenues for investigating biological systems by achieving subcellular spatial resolution. Since cells are the fundamental units of life, extracting single-cell information from high-resolution ST data is crucial. However, existing ST platforms often capture sparse transcript counts per spot or measure only a limited number of genes, complicating the extraction of comprehensive single-cell information. In this study, we introduce CellART, a unified framework designed to extract single-cell information across diverse high-resolution ST platforms, including VisiumHD, Xenium, MERFISH, and Stereo-seq. By leveraging multimodal data, such as staining images, spatial transcriptomics data, and single-cell RNA sequencing references, CellART simultaneously performs cell segmentation and cell type annotation through a seamless integration of deep learning and probabilistic modeling. We demonstrate the efficiency, generalizability, and robustness of CellART across various high-resolution spatial transcriptomics platforms, capable of processing datasets containing millions of spots. Comprehensive experiments validate the biological relevance and accuracy of the recovered cellular information within spatial configurations. Notably, we highlight the utility of CellART in breast and colorectal cancer datasets, showcasing its ability to fully leverage high-resolution ST data. By enhancing cellular resolution, CellART facilitates the identification of transient cancer cell states and immune cell subtypes. Furthermore, CellART enables investigations into cancer-immune cell communication, uncovering both established interactions and novel ligand-receptor pairs. The outputs of CellART are compatible with widely used community tools, facilitating a variety of downstream analyses.
items.summary_zh: CellART整合染色图像、空间转录组和scRNA-seq参考，在多种高分辨率空间转录组平台上联合进行细胞分割与细胞类型注释。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架面向跨平台、百万级spot空间组学的单细胞信息恢复；其癌症通信发现目前仍是预印本中的计算分析结果。
items.abstract_zh: 理解不同细胞类型如何组装成组织和器官，以及它们如何相互作用以传递和接收生物信号，对于推动生物医学和生物学研究至关重要。空间转录组学（ST）技术的近期进展通过实现亚细胞空间分辨率，为研究生物系统开辟了新途径。由于细胞是生命的基本单位，从高分辨率ST数据中提取单细胞信息至关重要。然而，现有ST平台常常每个spot捕获的转录本计数稀疏，或仅测量有限数量的基因，使得提取全面的单细胞信息变得复杂。在本研究中，我们介绍CellART：一个统一框架，旨在从包括VisiumHD、Xenium、MERFISH和Stereo-seq在内的多种高分辨率ST平台中提取单细胞信息。通过利用染色图像、空间转录组数据和单细胞RNA测序参考等多模态数据，CellART经由深度学习与概率建模的无缝整合，同时进行细胞分割和细胞类型注释。我们展示了CellART在多种高分辨率空间转录组平台上的效率、泛化能力和稳健性，能够处理包含数百万spot的数据集。全面实验验证了在空间构型中恢复的细胞信息的生物学相关性和准确性。值得注意的是，我们突出展示了CellART在乳腺癌和结直肠癌数据集中的实用性，表明它能够充分利用高分辨率ST数据。通过提高细胞分辨率，CellART有助于识别短暂的癌细胞状态和免疫细胞亚型。此外，CellART能够研究癌症—免疫细胞通信，揭示既有相互作用和新的配体—受体对。CellART的输出与广泛使用的社区工具兼容，便于开展多种下游分析。
items.author_line: Chen, Y., Liu, Y., Wang, Z., Zeng, Y., Chao, Z., Jiang, P., Chen, H., Wang, J., Xiao, J., Yang, C.

items.title: Uncovering neural decisions: How textual interpretation bridges AI and clinical reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Medical imaging artificial intelligence (AI) can achieve strong diagnostic performance, yet its decision evidence often remains difficult to verify, raising concerns about reliability and safety in clinical use. Conventional heatmaps mainly localize model-attended lesion regions and have limited capacity to distinguish multiple overlapping clinical features, whereas image-text explanations may describe the image content without being coupled to the actual decision pathway of the target model. Here, we present CRysTal, a neuron-level post-hoc explanation framework that maps decision-related neuronal activations to standardized clinical terminology through two-stage non-negative sparse regression and cross-category fusion. In breast ultrasound diagnosis, CRysTal linked neurons from EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50, VGG-19, and ViT-B models to BI-RADS concepts, generating explanations that were more consistent with radiology reports than large-model reasoning, CLIP-Dissect, and linear explanation baselines while preserving the original classification performance. Across the four diagnostic models, CRysTal improved feature-level agreement by 3.4-12.2% and tendency-level agreement by 3.5-19.2% over the second-best baseline. CRysTal further tracked a shift in model explanations during training, from non-specific visual cues toward clinical concepts commonly used by physicians, with concept alignment positively associated with diagnostic performance in ResNet-50 and EfficientNet-B0 (Pearson r = 0.89 and 0.84, respectively). Its reasoning conflict (RCF) score identified erroneous AI predictions with an AUC of 0.745, outperforming saliency-map-based risk signals (AUC range, 0.542-0.625) and a concept bottleneck model (AUC = 0.643). In a reader study involving 20 ultrasound physicians, CRysTal explanations received mean scores close to 97 for explanation accuracy, readability and guideline concordance, and reduced mean reading time by 10.7% for junior physicians and 4.7% for senior experts. Generalization experiments on external breast ultrasound, thyroid ultrasound and dermoscopy datasets provide initial evidence that CRysTal can support auditable AI explanations across standardized medical imaging terminology systems.
items.summary_zh: CRysTal将影像分类网络中与决策相关的神经元激活映射到BI-RADS概念，并在乳腺超声及外部影像数据上评估解释一致性与风险信号。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它尝试把事后解释与标准化临床术语及读片者研究相连；结果为预印本，解释与真实决策机制的一致性仍需独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：医学影像人工智能（AI）能够取得较强的诊断性能，但其决策证据往往仍难以验证，引发对临床使用中可靠性和安全性的担忧。传统热图主要定位模型关注的病灶区域，区分多个重叠临床特征的能力有限；而图像—文本解释可以描述图像内容，却未必与目标模型实际的决策路径耦合。这里我们提出CRysTal：一种神经元层面的事后解释框架，通过两阶段非负稀疏回归和跨类别融合，将与决策相关的神经元激活映射到标准化临床术语。在乳腺超声诊断中，CRysTal将EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50、VGG-19和ViT-B模型的神经元与BI-RADS概念关联，在保持原始分类性能的同时，生成的解释比大模型推理、CLIP-Dissect和线性解释基线与放射学报告更一致。相较于第二佳基线，在四个诊断模型中，CRysTal将特征层面一致性提高3.4–12.2%，将趋势层面一致性提高3.5–19.2%。CRysTal还追踪到训练期间模型解释发生的转变：从非特异性视觉线索转向医生常用的临床概念；在ResNet-50和EfficientNet-B0中，概念对齐与诊断性能呈正相关（Pearson r分别为0.89和0.84）。其推理冲突（RCF）评分以0.745的AUC识别错误AI预测，优于基于显著性图的风险信号（AUC范围0.542–0.625）和概念瓶颈模型（AUC=0.643）。在涉及20名超声医师的读片者研究中，CRysTal解释在解释准确性、可读性和指南一致性上获得接近97分的平均分，并将初级医师的平均阅片时间减少10.7%，将高级专家的平均阅片时间减少4.7%。在外部乳腺超声、甲状腺超声和皮肤镜数据集上的泛化实验提供了初步证据，表明CRysTal可支持跨标准化医学影像术语系统的可审计AI解释。
items.author_line: Lu H

items.title: NeuroRAD-FM: A Distributionally Robust Foundation Model for Precision Neuro-Oncology
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Foundation models for neuro-oncology have shown promise for non-invasive molecular characterization and prognostication, yet their clinical utility remains limited by cross-institutional distribution shift and poor performance on under-represented molecular alterations. We developed NeuroRAD-FM, combining self-supervised pretraining, Group-DRO, and a multi-backbone ensemble to learn site-invariant imaging representations. NeuroRAD-FM is pretrained on 7,414 multi-sequence brain MRI examinations aggregated from multiple institutions and evaluated on independent glioma cohorts from UCSF (n = 111), UPenn (n = 95), and an in-house cohort (n = 292). Downstream tasks included automated tumor segmentation, molecular biomarker prediction, and overall survival prediction. Compared with conventional foundation models, NeuroRAD-FM learned more site-invariant features, improved tumor segmentation across tumor types, significantly enhanced molecular marker prediction, and increased concordance indices across all institutions. These findings suggest that integrating Group-DRO with a multi-backbone foundation model enables robust, site-invariant representation learning and substantially improves molecular subtype and survival prediction across diverse neuro-oncology cohorts.
items.summary_zh: NeuroRAD-FM结合自监督预训练、Group-DRO和多骨干集成，在多机构脑MRI上训练并于独立胶质瘤队列评估分割、分子标志物和生存预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将跨机构分布偏移作为明确问题，并报告三个独立队列；其临床预测结论仍为预印本中的回顾性评估。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：神经肿瘤学基础模型已显示出用于无创分子表征和预后判断的前景，但其临床效用仍受限于跨机构分布偏移以及对代表不足的分子改变预测性能不佳。我们开发了NeuroRAD-FM，将自监督预训练、Group-DRO和多骨干集成结合起来，以学习站点不变的影像表示。NeuroRAD-FM在汇集自多个机构的7,414项多序列脑MRI检查上进行预训练，并在来自UCSF（n=111）、UPenn（n=95）和内部队列（n=292）的独立胶质瘤队列中评估。下游任务包括自动肿瘤分割、分子生物标志物预测和总生存期预测。与常规基础模型相比，NeuroRAD-FM学习到了更具站点不变性的特征，改善了跨肿瘤类型的肿瘤分割，显著增强了分子标志物预测，并提高了所有机构中的一致性指数。这些发现表明，将Group-DRO与多骨干基础模型整合，能够实现稳健、站点不变的表示学习，并显著改善不同神经肿瘤学队列中的分子亚型和生存预测。
items.author_line: Bhattacharya M, Singh A, Kurtz AP, Iwamoto FM, Prasanna P, Singh G

items.title: Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以答案分布轨迹而非终点准确率或熵曲线表征推理过程，并在 16 个开放权重模型和 4 个推理基准上比较不同轨迹动力学。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将推理评估从单一终点扩展到可比较的预测分布演化；摘要报告同终点、相近熵的轨迹仍可不同，但这是一种分析框架，不等同于证明更强的数学求解能力。
items.abstract_zh: 思维链推理在模型输入和最终答案之间提供了结构化计算。然而，它通常通过终点准确率进行评估，忽略了到达答案所经历的路径。新兴的一类工作使用熵曲线来追踪推理过程中不确定性如何演化，以解决这一局限，但它们无法揭示哪些竞争性假设造成了这种不确定性。我们引入答案分布轨迹，这是一种受随机动力学启发的表示，用于追踪推理展开时模型关于答案的完整预测分布。作为比终点和熵摘要严格更精细的表示，答案分布轨迹使我们能够用涵盖探索、修订、运动和承诺的动力学推理剖面刻画一条轨迹，并区分推理成功和失败的不同动力学机制。在 16 个开放权重语言模型和 4 个推理基准上，我们表明，具有相同终点和相近熵曲线的轨迹可能呈现显著不同的推理动力学。我们还发现，这些动力学在模型和任务内部及之间均存在显著差异，不同目标偏好不同的动力学剖面。此外，我们表明训练和推理选择会系统性地重塑这些剖面。结果表明，答案分布轨迹为分析和评估 LLM 推理动力学提供了一个丰富框架。
items.author_line: Mar Gonzàlez I Català, Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde, Davide Murari, Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb, Pietro Liò, George Montañez

items.title: Beyond Polar Addition: A Radical Alternative for Enantioselective C–C Bond Formation Driven by Alkylzirconocenes Dual Reactivity
items.abstract_or_text: The catalytic asymmetric addition of organometallic reagents to carbonyl compounds represents a fundamental strategy for the synthesis of enantioenriched alcohols. However, conventional carbanionic nucleophiles (e.g., organomagnesium and organolithium) often suffer from competing deprotonation pathways, uncatalyzed background reactions, limited functional-group tolerance, and sensitivity to moisture and air. Alkylzirconocenes, readily generated from abundant alkenes, offer an attractive alternative by virtue of their functional‑group compatibility, photochemical lability, and capacity for remote chain‑walking. Herein, we report a visible-light-enabled, nickel-catalyzed asymmetric radical addition of alkylzirconocenes to aliphatic aldehydes, providing efficient access to enantioenriched secondary alcohols in good yields with high levels of enantioselectivities. This transformation features broad functional-group tolerance, enabling the late-stage enantioselective modification of complex pharmaceutical molecules and natural products. Notably, alkylzirconocenes serve a dual role in this process, acting as both alkyl radical precursors and sources of Zr(III) species for carbonyl activation. Mechanistic investigations, including control experiments, radical‑clock experiments, kinetic analysis, nonlinear effect studies, support a nickel-catalyzed asymmetric radical addition pathway, wherein a Zr(III) species mediates the single-electron reduction of aliphatic aldehydes to generate ketyl radicals. This work establishes a new paradigm for asymmetric carbonyl addition that circumvents the intrinsic limitations of classical polar mechanisms.
items.summary_zh: 报道可见光驱动、Ni 催化的 alkylzirconocenes 对脂肪醛不对称自由基加成；alkylzirconocenes 同时充当烷基自由基前体和生成 Zr(III) 的来源，得到高对映选择性仲醇。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将易得烯烃转化为兼具自由基供体和羰基活化功能的试剂，扩展了不对称羰基加成策略；实际底物广度、收率和 ee 分布仍需以全文数据判断。
items.abstract_zh: 有机金属试剂对羰基化合物的催化不对称加成，是合成对映体富集醇的一项基础策略。然而，常规碳负离子亲核试剂（如有机镁和有机锂）常遭遇竞争性去质子化路径、未经催化的背景反应、有限的官能团耐受性以及对水分和空气的敏感性。由丰富烯烃方便生成的 alkylzirconocenes，凭借其官能团兼容性、光化学不稳定性和远程 chain-walking 能力，提供了一个有吸引力的替代方案。本文报道了一种可见光促进、镍催化的 alkylzirconocenes 对脂肪醛的不对称自由基加成，可高效获得具有高对映选择性的对映体富集仲醇。该转化具有广泛官能团耐受性，使复杂药物分子和天然产物的晚期对映选择性修饰成为可能。值得注意的是，alkylzirconocenes 在该过程中发挥双重作用，既作为烷基自由基前体，也作为用于羰基活化的 Zr(III) 物种来源。包括对照实验、自由基时钟实验、动力学分析和非线性效应研究在内的机制研究，支持一条镍催化不对称自由基加成路径；其中 Zr(III) 物种介导脂肪醛的单电子还原以生成 ketyl radicals。本工作建立了一种新的不对称羰基加成范式，规避了经典极性机制的内在局限。
items.author_line: Wenqian Miao, Songlin Bai, Qingcui Wu, Xiangbing Qi

items.title: New Paradigm in Ligand Coupling: Formation of C(sp2)–C(sp) Bonds by Hypervalent Bismuth
items.abstract_or_text: Ligand coupling is the principal bond-forming reaction of hypervalent main-group compounds, resulting in the formation of diverse carbon–carbon and carbon–heteroatom bonds. Hypervalent organobismuth reagents are known to undergo ligand coupling to form C–O, C–N, C–S, and carbon–halogen bonds, together with carbon–carbon bonds between enolates and aryl groups or alkenes, and phenoxides and aryl groups. Despite four decades of development in organobismuth chemistry, however, coupling between aryl and alkynyl ligands has remained unreported. Here we show that hypervalent organobismuth undergoes aryl–alkynyl coupling through a previously unknown elementary ligand-coupling reaction. A conformationally constrained, recoverable organobismuth scaffold enables selective aryl transfer to terminal alkynes under mild, transition-metal-free conditions. Mechanistic studies support the intermediacy of a pentacoordinate Bi(V) species that is observable by variable-temperature NMR and capable of ligand exchange prior to reductive coupling. These studies establish aryl–alkynyl coupling as a new elementary reaction of hypervalent organobismuth compounds.
items.summary_zh: 发现超价有机铋可经此前未知的 elementary ligand-coupling reaction 实现芳基–炔基偶联；可回收、构象受限的 organobismuth scaffold 支持温和无过渡金属条件下的末端炔烃芳基化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为超价主族化合物的配体偶联增添 C(sp2)–C(sp) 成键基元，可能拓展低金属负担的合成路线；反应普适性和在复杂合成中的实用性仍需进一步评估。
evidence_flags: 底物普适性待全文核验
items.abstract_zh: 配体偶联是超价主族化合物的主要成键反应，可形成多样的碳–碳键和碳–杂原子键。已知超价有机铋试剂可进行配体偶联，形成 C–O、C–N、C–S 和碳–卤素键，也可形成烯醇盐与芳基或烯烃之间、以及酚盐与芳基之间的碳–碳键。然而，尽管有机铋化学已发展四十年，芳基与炔基配体之间的偶联仍未有报道。我们在此表明，超价有机铋可通过一种此前未知的基元配体偶联反应发生芳基–炔基偶联。一个构象受限、可回收的有机铋骨架，使得在温和、无过渡金属条件下能够选择性地将芳基转移至末端炔烃。机制研究支持可变温 NMR 可观察到的五配位 Bi(V) 物种作为中间体；该物种可在还原偶联前发生配体交换。这些研究确立了芳基–炔基偶联作为超价有机铋化合物的一种新的基元反应。
items.author_line: Yun-Jeong Shin, Li Li, Viresh H. Rawal

items.title: A radiographic world model for clinical reasoning and evidence generation
items.abstract_or_text: Medical imaging artificial intelligence (AI) is commonly developed as separate mappings from radiographs to diagnostic outputs or from clinical descriptions to generated images, although both arise from the same underlying radiographic state. A world-model formulation instead seeks to learn an internal representation of this state that can support both clinical readout and conditional simulation of radiographic observations. Here we introduce MedDream, a radiographic world model that learns a shared continuous latent state from paired chest radiograph-text observations for diagnostic reasoning and report-conditioned evidence generation. MedDream was pretrained on 2.65 million leakage-controlled chest radiograph-text pairs curated from 4.40 million candidates. Across eight clinical datasets and two independent reader cohorts, MedDream outperformed leading diagnostic and generative comparators. For diagnostic reasoning, MedDream showed strong generalization across disease recognition, label-scarce adaptation, severity assessment, and localization, while MedDream-supported review increased mean resident concordance with independent radiologist consensus from 56.3% to 63.0%. For evidence generation, MedDream produced radiographs that preserved clinically relevant pathology and improved downstream performance on held-out real data, with synthetic augmentation increasing external VinDr-CXR macro-AUROC from 76.4% to 81.4%. More importantly, conditioning generation on prespecified subgroup performance gaps enabled targeted evidence construction, increasing weighted F1 by 3.1 percentage points in Asian patients, whereas matched-volume unguided augmentation decreased it by 2.3 points. These findings establish radiographic world models as a path toward medical AI that learns clinically meaningful internal states for interpreting, simulating, and constructing evidence for clinical use.
items.summary_zh: MedDream以大规模胸片—报告配对数据学习共享的放射影像潜变量，并在诊断推理与条件性影像生成任务中进行评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 2.65百万对泄漏控制数据及跨数据集读片评估使其成为值得关注的医学影像世界模型预印本；临床效用仍需前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 医学影像人工智能（AI）通常被开发为从X线片到诊断输出，或从临床描述到生成影像的彼此独立映射，尽管二者都源自同一潜在的放射影像状态。世界模型的表述则旨在学习这一状态的内部表示，从而同时支持临床读出和放射影像观察结果的条件模拟。这里我们提出MedDream：一种放射影像世界模型，它从配对的胸部X线片—文本观察中学习共享的连续潜在状态，用于诊断推理和报告条件化的证据生成。MedDream在从4.40百万个候选样本整理出的2.65百万个经过数据泄漏控制的胸部X线片—文本对上进行预训练。在八个临床数据集和两个独立读片者队列中，MedDream优于领先的诊断和生成对照方法。在诊断推理方面，MedDream在疾病识别、标签稀缺适应、严重程度评估和定位方面表现出较强的泛化能力；MedDream辅助阅片将住院医师与独立放射科医师共识的一致性均值从56.3%提高至63.0%。在证据生成方面，MedDream生成的X线片保留了临床相关病理，并提高了在留出真实数据上的下游性能；合成数据增强将外部VinDr-CXR的宏平均AUROC从76.4%提高到81.4%。更重要的是，按预先指定的亚组性能差距对生成进行条件化，可实现有针对性的证据构建，使亚洲患者的加权F1提高3.1个百分点，而等体量、无引导的增强使其下降2.3个百分点。这些发现将放射影像世界模型确立为一条通向医学AI的路径：该类模型学习具有临床意义的内部状态，用于解释、模拟和构建临床使用的证据。
items.author_line: Suyang Xi, Songtao Hu, Shansong Wang, Mojtaba Safari, Luke del Balzo, Ehsan Ul Karim, Mingzhe Hu, Kuo Zhang, Tonghe Wang, Ralph R. Weichselbaum, Xiaofeng Yang

items.title: Deep Learning for Biopsy-Free Subtyping of Basal Cell Carcinoma from Dermatoscopic Images
items.abstract_or_text: Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC) is the most common type of skin cancer, accounting for nearly 80% of skin cancer di- agnoses. Its optimal clinical management is guided by the distinct histopathologic subtype, with aggressive variants requiring more drastic measures. In current clinical practice, subtyping relies on skin biopsies, a procedure both costly and invasive. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary investigation into using deep learning for BCC subtyping, solely from a single dermatoscopic image of the lesion. Given the limited data at our disposal, we employ pre-trained vision transformers (ViTs), a state-of-the-art family of models highly effective for challenging downstream tasks with limited labeled data. Through repeated stratified k-fold cross-validation, we demonstrate that ViTs can achieve superior performance (AUC 0.784 on a dataset of 1271 dermatoscopic images of various BCC subtypes) over standard CNN-based baselines as well as previously-reported human reader perfor- mance, on the task of differentiating aggressive BCCs from other subtype families. These initial findings highlight the potential of combining deep learning and dermatoscopy to provide a biopsy- free alternative for BCC subtyping, thus aiding in improving treatment planning and patient outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 该初步研究以1,271张皮肤镜图像和重复分层k折交叉验证，评估ViT区分侵袭性BCC与其他亚型家族的能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它面向病理亚型这一临床相关问题，但仅为有限数据下的初步预印本研究，不能据此替代活检。
items.abstract_zh: 基底细胞癌（BCC）是最常见的皮肤癌类型，约占皮肤癌诊断的80%。其最佳临床管理由不同的组织病理学亚型指导，其中侵袭性变异型需要更激进的措施。在当前临床实践中，亚型判定依赖皮肤活检，这一程序既昂贵又具侵入性。本文对仅从病灶的一张皮肤镜图像使用深度学习进行BCC分型开展初步研究。鉴于我们可获得的数据有限，我们采用预训练视觉Transformer（ViT），这是一类在带标签数据有限的挑战性下游任务中十分有效的先进模型家族。通过重复分层k折交叉验证，我们证明在区分侵袭性BCC与其他亚型家族的任务上，ViT可取得优于标准CNN基线以及先前报告的人类读片者表现的性能（在包含各种BCC亚型的1,271张皮肤镜图像数据集上AUC为0.784）。这些初步发现突出了将深度学习与皮肤镜检查相结合、提供一种无活检BCC分型替代方案的潜力，从而有助于改善治疗规划和患者结局。
items.author_line: Alexandros Papadopoulos, Chrysa Episkopou, Ioannis Sarafis, Aimilios Lallas, Anastasios Delopoulos

items.title: UKB-KG: Knowledge Graph for Integrating and Enhancing Biomedical Insights from the UK Biobank
items.abstract_or_text: The UK Biobank (UKB) is a cornerstone of modern biomedical research, providing unparalleled data to advance the understanding, prediction, and treatment of diseases. Its contributions span genetics, genomics, disease prediction, and long-term follow-up studies, driving transformative advancements in public health and precision medicine. However, the fragmentation of research outcomes across numerous publications limits analytic efficiency and cross-study integration. To address this, we developed UKB Knowledge Graph (UKB-KG), a high-quality medical knowledge graph constructed using large language models (LLMs) with 88.8% precision as assessed by GPT-5.4. Integrating data from approximately 9,200 UKB-related publications. UKB-KG comprises 292,328 triples enriched with contextual attributes such as source information and demographic details. It reveals intricate relationships among diseases, genes, chemicals, lifestyle factors, and other biomedical entities, while a dynamic scoring mechanism enhances triple retrieval accuracy. Evaluations highlight UKB-KG's transformative potential. (i) Embedding UKB-KG into multi-disease prediction models improves AUROC, AUPRC, and F1 scores by 8.1%, 6.2%, and 2.7%, respectively, for rare diseases. (ii) A tailored retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach boosted LLM accuracy by 13.2% on PubMedQA. and (iii) A user-friendly platform enhances accessibility for researchers. By unifying fragmented research and enabling robust data exploration, UKB-KG emerges as a powerful tool for advancing biomedical research and driving innovative healthcare applications.
items.summary_zh: UKB-KG用LLM整合约9,200篇UK Biobank相关论文，构建含292,328个带上下文属性三元组的医学知识图谱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该资源试图把UK Biobank研究结果结构化并连接疾病、基因、化学物和生活方式因素；其精度评估使用GPT-5.4，仍需要独立人工核验。
items.abstract_zh: UK Biobank（UKB）是现代生物医学研究的基石，提供了无与伦比的数据以推动对疾病的理解、预测和治疗。其贡献涵盖遗传学、基因组学、疾病预测和长期随访研究，推动了公共卫生和精准医学的变革性进展。然而，大量论文中研究结局的碎片化限制了分析效率和跨研究整合。为解决这一问题，我们开发了UKB Knowledge Graph（UKB-KG）：一个使用大语言模型（LLM）构建的高质量医学知识图谱，经GPT-5.4评估的精确率为88.8%。UKB-KG整合了约9,200篇UKB相关论文的数据，包含292,328个三元组，并富集了来源信息和人口统计学细节等上下文属性。它揭示疾病、基因、化学物、生活方式因素和其他生物医学实体之间复杂的关系，同时一个动态评分机制提高三元组检索准确性。评估突出了UKB-KG的变革性潜力：（i）将UKB-KG嵌入多疾病预测模型后，罕见病的AUROC、AUPRC和F1评分分别提高8.1%、6.2%和2.7%；（ii）一种定制的检索增强生成（RAG）方法使LLM在PubMedQA上的准确率提高13.2%；以及（iii）一个用户友好平台提高了研究人员的可及性。通过统一碎片化研究并支持稳健的数据探索，UKB-KG成为推动生物医学研究和创新医疗应用的强大工具。
items.author_line: Wang, Z., Wang, J., Shen, Y., Gao, S., Chen, Y., Chen, H., Cheng, C., Yu, K., Zhu, H., Ye, J.

items.title: CircuitLens: Reasoning Circuits as Data Selection Signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is sensitive to which problems a model trains on, yet existing selection criteria--difficulty filtering, hand-curation, reward-trajectory scoring--assess data value as an intrinsic property of problems, independent of the model that will learn from them. We introduce Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS), a selection signal derived from 46 reasoning-sensitive attention heads identified via contrastive ablation, computed in a single forward pass on the frozen base model without reward labels or rollouts. CRS runs against the intuitive hypothesis that stronger reasoning-circuit engagement produces better training data: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the lowest-engagement decile improves over random selection on three medium-difficulty benchmarks (GSM8K +2.0 pp, OlympiadBench +1.6 pp, Minerva +2.9 pp), while the highest-engagement decile gains less and is indistinguishable from the middle decile. The advantage has boundary conditions: on a domain-curated pool no selection method separates from the others; at 1.5B scale the useful direction differs; and the lowest-reward training condition produces the strongest downstream generalization. Within the Qwen2.5-Math settings tested, RLVR data selection appears regime-dependent rather than reducible to a static ranking of problem quality.
items.summary_zh: CircuitLens 以冻结模型中经对比消融识别的 46 个注意力头构造数据选择信号 CRS，并在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的 RLVR 训练中检验其对数学推理泛化的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究报告了 GSM8K、OlympiadBench 和 Minerva 上的具体增益，也明确给出规模、数据池和奖励条件的边界，避免把机制信号表述为普遍有效的题目质量排序。
items.abstract_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对模型训练所使用的问题十分敏感，但现有选择准则——难度筛选、人工整理、奖励轨迹评分——将数据价值视为独立于将要学习的模型的问题内在属性。我们引入 Circuit Reasoning Score（CRS），这是一种从通过对比消融识别出的 46 个推理敏感注意力头导出的选择信号；它在冻结基座模型上仅需一次前向传播即可计算，无需奖励标签或 rollout。CRS 的结果与“更强的推理回路参与度产生更好的训练数据”这一直觉假设相反：在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上，最低参与度的十分位组相较随机选择，在三个中等难度基准上取得提升（GSM8K +2.0 个百分点、OlympiadBench +1.6 个百分点、Minerva +2.9 个百分点）；最高参与度十分位组的增益较小，且与中间十分位组无法区分。该优势具有边界条件：在一个领域人工整理的数据池上，没有任何选择方法能与其他方法区分开；在 1.5B 规模上，有效方向不同；而最低奖励的训练条件产生了最强的下游泛化。在所测试的 Qwen2.5-Math 设置中，RLVR 数据选择似乎依赖于具体训练区间，而不能归结为对问题质量的静态排序。
items.author_line: Zhuofan Chen, Ziqian Jiao, Yikai Cui, Zhixin Cai, Jun Bai, Wenge Rong

items.title: Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs, localizing targets from directional language remains challenging, even when observer grounding is made explicit. We find that explicit breakdowns of observer-relative spatial reasoning improve target localization. Our project page is available at https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出 POVBench，将多视角三维场景中的观察者定位任务拆分为推断、明示和给定三种条件，以评估视觉语言模型的情境化空间推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 基准的目标和输入输出关系清晰，并指出即使观察者视角被明示，方向性语言定位仍有困难；摘要未将该结果泛化为模型具备稳健三维理解。
items.abstract_zh: 在机器人等具身任务中，对语言指令进行推理通常要求从说话者所处的视角理解空间关系。人类会根据共享的环境知识、活动语境和常识推断此类视角。近期视觉语言模型（VLM）似乎能够进行空间推理，但它们能否从语境线索中推断说话者视点，并从该视点解释情境化空间关系，仍不清楚。我们将这种能力称为情境化观察者落地。为研究这一能力，我们构建了 Point-of-View Benchmark（POVBench），这是一个由三维场景和查询构成的数据集，用以区分具身自然交流中观察者落地的推断、明示和给定形式。给定多视角观察和一句自然语言语句，模型必须从情境化的空间与语境线索中定位未见或描述不足的目标。对最先进 VLM 的测试表明，即使观察者落地被明确给出，从方向性语言中定位目标仍然困难。我们发现，对观察者相对空间推理进行显式分解可改善目标定位。我们的项目页面位于 https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/。
items.author_line: Mimo Shirasaka, Haochen Zhang, Yonatan Bisk

items.title: Robust Conformal Consensus: Multi-Agent LLM-as-a-Judge Interval Evaluation with Conformal Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: LLM-as-a-Judge has emerged as a promising paradigm for evaluating natural language generation. However, the uncertainty associated with such evaluations remains largely unexplored, which limits their reliability in real-world applications. Although conformal prediction offers a principled framework for uncertainty quantification, existing approaches typically apply it to a single LLM judge, overlooking the variability introduced by using different LLM evaluators. In this work, we propose a robust uncertainty estimation framework for multi-agent LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our approach constructs conformal prediction intervals for LLM-based scores from multiple LLMs. By considering intervals from different LLM judges, we obtain more stable and reliable uncertainty estimates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces valid prediction intervals with coverage guarantees, and that interval-based aggregation across multiple judges leads to more stable evaluation outcomes.
items.summary_zh: Robust Conformal Consensus 为多个 LLM 裁判的评分分别构造共形预测区间，再以区间聚合量化评价不确定性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 相较只输出单点裁判分数，该方法的目标是可检验的覆盖率保证与跨裁判稳定性；摘要未披露实验数据集和具体覆盖率，因此结论应限于作者报告的评测范围。
items.abstract_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge 已成为评估自然语言生成的一种有前景范式。然而，这类评价相关的不确定性仍在很大程度上未被探索，这限制了其在真实应用中的可靠性。尽管共形预测为不确定性量化提供了有原则的框架，现有方法通常将其应用于单一 LLM 裁判，忽略了使用不同 LLM 评估者引入的变异性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于多智能体 LLM-as-a-Judge 评价的稳健不确定性估计框架。我们的方法为多个 LLM 的评分构造共形预测区间。通过考虑不同 LLM 裁判的区间，我们获得了更稳定、更可靠的不确定性估计。大量实验表明，该方法产生具有覆盖率保证的有效预测区间，并且跨多个裁判的基于区间的聚合带来更稳定的评价结果。

items.title: Agentic BAIM-LLM Evaluation (ABLE): Benchmarking LLM Use of Protein Design Tools
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce ABLE, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to use biological AI models (BAIMs), such as ProteinMPNN and AlphaFold3, in dual-use protein design workflows. ABLE assesses agent performance through a set of tasks spanning structure retrieval, sequence generation, and design validation. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find that seven refuse all tasks, while the remaining models exhibit substantial performance differences. Claude Sonnet 4 and Gemini 3 Pro achieve the highest scores across information retrieval, tool selection, and tool use. We further compare model performance on a subset of tasks against an expert human baseline. Our results suggest that current LLMs can substantially lower barriers to protein design, but remain inconsistent in planning, strategy generation, and integrating biological knowledge with tool use.
items.summary_zh: ABLE以结构检索、序列生成和设计验证任务，评估15个前沿LLM在ProteinMPNN、AlphaFold3等工具参与的双用途蛋白设计流程中的表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准将蛋白设计工具使用拆分为可评估步骤，并与专家人工基线比较；摘要所述结果提示能力差异与规划不稳定性。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出ABLE：一个基准，用于评估LLM智能体在双用途蛋白设计工作流中使用生物AI模型（BAIM），如ProteinMPNN和AlphaFold3的能力。ABLE通过一组涵盖结构检索、序列生成和设计验证的任务评估智能体性能。我们评估了15个前沿模型，发现其中7个拒绝所有任务，而其余模型表现出显著的性能差异。Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 3 Pro在信息检索、工具选择和工具使用方面取得最高分。我们还在一部分任务上将模型性能与专家人工基线进行比较。我们的结果表明，当前LLM可大幅降低蛋白质设计的门槛，但在规划、策略生成以及将生物学知识与工具使用相整合方面仍不一致。

items.title: UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning (RL) excels on tasks with verifiable rewards, but in open-ended tasks, the reliability of reward models remains a key challenge. Existing solutions either depend on costly proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge systems or opaque scalar reward models that lack interpretability. Recent works on generative reward models offer a promising alternative, but they remain constrained by static evaluation criteria, fragmented evaluation paradigms, and limited multilingual support. To address these challenges, we introduce MixReward, a large-scale multilingual dataset spanning six domains and 103 languages, containing both pairwise and listwise data, and propose UniRRM, a unified reasoning reward model supporting multiple languages and evaluation paradigms. UniRRM uses a staged reasoning chain to dynamically generate task-generic and instruction-specific criteria, enabling fine-grained, input-adaptive judgments while maintaining consistency across languages. Experiments demonstrate that UniRRM-8B and UniRRM-14B achieve performance close to the state-of-the-art for models of comparable size across multiple benchmarks, and are effective for unseen evaluation paradigms. In addition, ablation studies validate the reliability and effectiveness of UniRRM.
items.summary_zh: UniRRM 以覆盖 6 个领域、103 种语言的 MixReward 数据集训练统一推理奖励模型，支持成对与列表式评价，并通过分阶段推理链动态生成评价准则。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开放式任务的奖励可靠性会直接影响强化学习和模型比较。摘要报告了跨基准、未见评价范式及消融实验，但“接近同规模最优”的具体差距未在摘要中给出。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在具有可验证奖励的任务上表现出色，但在开放式任务中，奖励模型的可靠性仍是关键挑战。现有方案要么依赖昂贵的专有 LLM-as-a-Judge 系统，要么依赖缺乏可解释性的黑箱标量奖励模型。近期关于生成式奖励模型的工作提供了一个有前景的替代方案，但它们仍受制于静态评价准则、割裂的评价范式和有限的多语言支持。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了 MixReward——一个覆盖 6 个领域和 103 种语言的大规模多语言数据集，包含成对和列表式数据；并提出 UniRRM——一个支持多种语言和评价范式的统一推理奖励模型。UniRRM 使用分阶段推理链，动态生成任务通用和指令特定的准则，从而在保持跨语言一致性的同时，实现细粒度、可随输入调整的判断。实验表明，在多个基准上，UniRRM-8B 和 UniRRM-14B 对于同等规模模型取得了接近最先进水平的表现，并且对未见过的评价范式有效。此外，消融研究验证了 UniRRM 的可靠性和有效性。

Buckmaster and Levent Alpöge had spent most of the past year pushing a program started by Diego Córdoba and Luis Martínez-Zoroza. Tristan Buckmaster’s statement is at cims.nyu.edu/~tristanb/statement.pdf
